描述(中文): 在拟真 3D 物理堆叠的麻将牌阵中挑出三张相同牌面装槽消除，活用洗牌、翻牌、消除与回退道具通关。
description(EN): Pick matching 3D mahjong tiles from a tumbling physics pile into your tray, using flip, shuffle, clear, and undo tools to empty the table.
controls: Tap 3D mahjong tiles to move them into the tray; match three identical tiles to clear them. Use Shuffle, Flip, Clear, and Undo buttons below.

描述(中文): 经典弓箭传说式肉鸽走位射击：单手拖动灵巧躲弹幕，停步瞬间自动连发散射神箭，叠加超爽词条一路清图打 Boss！
description(EN): Dodge incoming projectiles across crisp roguelike dungeon rooms, stop to unleash rapid spread-shot volleys, and stack crazy arrow power-ups.
controls: Drag anywhere to dodge enemy shots and reposition; release to automatically loose rapid arrow volleys at the nearest enemy.

描述(中文): 爆款都市识破伪装狙击：开启扫描仪揪出混在人群里的外星卧底，稳准开镜一枪命中，千万别误伤路人。
description(EN): Scan bustling city scenes with your visor, spot disguised extraterrestrials hiding in plain sight, and line up clean sniper shots without hitting civilians.
controls: Toggle scanner vision to expose hidden aliens, drag to aim your sniper scope, and release to fire.

描述(中文): 治愈魔性物理堆叠动物叠高楼：把圆滚滚的大象、熊猫和长颈鹿一只只稳稳叠上高空，考验重心平衡笑料十足！
description(EN): Balance quirky elephants, pandas, and giraffes one atop another in charming physics stacking—keep your swaying animal pyramid upright to set sky-high records.
controls: Position and rotate each cute animal overhead, then release gently to balance it atop your towering stack.

描述(中文): 一指入弯极限漂移赛车：入弯长按甩尾贴着弯心拉出完美烟带，出弯松手全速弹射，手感丝滑到停不下来！
description(EN): Nail razor-close hairpin drifts with one-thumb timing—hold to kick the tail out around tight corners and release to rocket down every straightaway.
controls: Press and hold before corners to initiate a drift, then release as you exit the apex to straighten out at full speed.

描述(中文): 超上头大鱼吃小鱼进化顶级食物链：从小生物开局不断吞噬弱小进化变身，躲避天敌一路吃成称霸全场的顶级掠食者！
description(EN): Start as a tiny critter and devour smaller creatures to evolve step by step—dodge apex predators until you grow into the ultimate king of the food chain.
controls: Drag to steer around the ecosystem, eat smaller targets to level up, and avoid higher-tier predators.

描述(中文): 现象级动作肉鸽鼻祖弓箭手传说：移动走位躲弹幕、停步自动连射箭雨，叠加弹射多重箭一路通关打爆 Boss！
description(EN): Run, stop, and loose rapid-fire arrow volleys across roguelike dungeon rooms—stack ricochet, multishot, and fire arrows to conquer every boss.
controls: Drag to dodge projectiles and release to stand still and auto-fire arrows at the nearest enemy.

描述(中文): 旋转观察悬浮在空中的 3D 立体箭头方块阵，找准毫无遮挡的突破口逐个弹射清空，解压又烧脑。
description(EN): Rotate and inspect a floating 3D cluster of directional arrow blocks, tapping unobstructed pieces to launch them free until the entire structure vanishes.
controls: Tap any unblocked arrow cube to slide it out in its pointing direction; drag to orbit the 3D puzzle cluster.

描述(中文): 抖音超火极简解压箭头消消：看准每个箭头的飞行朝向，按顺序点飞无遮挡方块，清空整盘强迫症极度爽！
description(EN): Tap directional arrow tiles in the exact unobstructed order so every piece zips cleanly off the board—a crisp, hyper-addictive spatial brain-teaser.
controls: Tap any arrow block whose forward path is unobstructed to launch it off the board until zero blocks remain.

描述(中文): 快节奏战术射击突击对决：依托掩体闪转腾挪，精准点射与手雷齐发击败精英特工小队！
description(EN): Take cover, sprint across tactical combat arenas, and outshoot elite squads in fast-paced arcade firefights packed with power-up drops.
controls: Move with touch controls to dodge enemy fire and lock onto targets to clear each combat arena.

描述(中文): 爆款格子背包合成肉鸽：每波战前自由摆放并合成升级剑、弓、匕首与扩容格，迎战 15 波怪物大军。
description(EN): Arrange and merge swords, bows, and daggers inside your grid backpack between waves, then unleash auto-battles across 15 escalating monster raids.
controls: Drag weapons and extra bag slots into your backpack, merge matching weapons to level up, tap Refresh for new gear, and hit Battle to fight.

描述(中文): 炫酷霓虹物理弹球激光消砖块：找准刁钻反弹角度发射满屏弹球，触发激光连环扫射一口气清屏超解压！
description(EN): Line up dazzling ricochet angles to launch plasma balls and slicing laser beams across geometric blocks in explosive neon chain reactions.
controls: Press and drag to aim your shot angle, then release to fire bouncing balls and trigger laser blasts across the board.

描述(中文): 一指划过满屏果冻感立体彩球，连得越长、爆得越爽！步数紧巴巴的时候甩出一颗骷髅炸弹瞬间清场，专治各种不开心。
description(EN): Trace long glossy chains across a 3D bubble grid, pop huge clusters before moves run dry, and drop bombs to blast through tight goals.
controls: Press and drag through adjacent balls of the same color, then release to pop. Trigger bombs when moves get tight.

描述(中文): 魔性手速解压徒手抓鱼：盯紧溪水里游来游去的肥鱼与锦鲤，瞅准时机快准狠一把抓起爽感爆棚！
description(EN): Time your lightning-fast grab in crystal-clear river streams to catch darting trout, crabs, and golden koi barehanded for massive combo hauls.
controls: Tap at the exact moment a fish swims into your reach zone to snatch it cleanly from the stream.

描述(中文): 热血策略塔防基地保卫战：部署重机枪炮塔与导弹阵列，灵活升级火力防线，抵御一波波装甲敌军猛烈进攻！
description(EN): Fortify your command outpost against wave after wave of armored invaders—place turrets, call airstrikes, and upgrade firepower to keep the base standing.
controls: Tap build slots to place and upgrade defense turrets, and trigger special support skills during boss waves.

描述(中文): 硬核改装对战战斗汽车竞技场：给战车焊上锯片火箭筒与装甲，开进竞技场正面硬刚撞翻所有对手！
description(EN): Bolt sawblades, rockets, and turbo boosters onto custom battle rigs, then slam head-to-head against rival war machines in explosive arena duels.
controls: Drive, boost, and trigger mounted weapons to flip or wreck your opponent's battle vehicle.

描述(中文): 魔性横版推塔猫咪大作战：召唤各具奇葩绝技的萌猫大军出击对推，攒能量放基地大炮一举推翻敌方堡垒！
description(EN): Deploy bizarre, lovable cat warriors from your home tower to push across the lane, smash quirky enemy waves, and topple the rival fortress.
controls: Tap cat unit icons as your funds refill to summon squads and fire your base cannon at enemy lines.

描述(中文): 清凉夏日风阳光沙滩足球：在椰林沙滩上来场爽快足球对决，凌空倒钩精准射门拿下夏日冠军杯！
description(EN): Kick up golden sand under sunny palm skies—time acrobatic bicycle volleys and crisp flick shots to dominate tropical beach football matches.
controls: Swipe or tap controls to aim kicks, pass along the sand, and score past the goalkeeper.

描述(中文): 治愈卡通横版跑酷小熊快跑：陪萌萌小熊在阳光森林一路狂奔跳跃，狂吃蜂蜜罐躲避障碍停不下来！
description(EN): Help an energetic little bear race across scenic forest bridges—bounce off mushrooms, collect sweet honey jars, and outrun mischievous bees.
controls: Tap to jump over logs and gaps while grabbing honey jars and speed boosts along the trail.

描述(中文): 科幻热血动作超能英雄战队：集结高科技超能战士联手释放能量光束，粉碎机械军团入侵守护未来都市！
description(EN): Assemble a futuristic team of super-powered heroes—unleash energy beams and shield bursts against relentless robotic invaders.
controls: Drag to move your hero squad, auto-fire plasma blasts, and trigger ultimate abilities.

描述(中文): 真实物理碰撞 3D 桌球竞技：清晰辅助瞄准线 + 丝滑蓄力推杆手感，精准走位连杆清台体验一杆进洞快感！
description(EN): Step up to a crisp 3D emerald felt pool table with realistic ball physics, dotted bank-shot guidelines, smooth power-cue control, and classic 8-ball table runs.
controls: Drag around the table to line up your cue aiming guideline, then pull back and release the power bar to strike the cue ball.

描述(中文): 超真实物理手感桌球大师训练：拉杆瞄准辅助线丝滑击球，练习翻袋走位一杆清台，随时随地过足台球瘾！
description(EN): Line up crisp bank angles, control cue power with smooth pullback physics, and pocket every striped and solid ball across precision pool drills.
controls: Drag to aim the cue stick toward your target ball, then pull back the power bar and release to strike.

描述(中文): 美食主题爆款消除餐厅消消消：消除诱人汉堡甜品触发连环爆破特效，攒星星装修你的网红人气小餐厅！
description(EN): Match sizzling burgers, desserts, and gourmet ingredients in a cheerful restaurant puzzle—chain power-up combos to satisfy VIP orders and renovate your diner.
controls: Swap or tap matching food tiles to clear order targets and trigger explosive kitchen boosters.

描述(中文): 魔性冷兵器乱斗刀剑争霸：在竞技场收集飞剑壮大刀阵，走位拉扯收割对手，化身满屏剑气的无敌剑圣！
description(EN): Enter a frantic IO sword-fighting arena—collect spinning blades, slash rivals from the flank, and grow an unstoppable ring of legendary steel.
controls: Drag to glide across the arena, pick up scattered swords to grow your blade ring, and cut down rivals.

描述(中文): 极致解压肉鸽割草旋转大师：一圈飞刀大斧环绕高速旋转，钻进怪堆瞬间切瓜砍菜满屏掉宝爽到飞起！
description(EN): Surround your hero with orbiting razors, axes, and plasma saws—weave into packed monster swarms to shred waves in ultra-satisfying circular bursts.
controls: Drag anywhere to steer your hero around the arena, collect blades and gems, and shred incoming hordes.

描述(中文): 「再放一块我就睡」——8×8 棋盘上的极致解压连消！把奇形怪状的彩块严丝合缝塞进空位，多行多列同时引爆那一秒，强迫症直接原地升天。
description(EN): Just one more piece — snap wild polyominoes into an 8x8 grid and detonate multi-line combos that scratch every perfectionist itch.
controls: Drag shapes from the tray onto the 8x8 board. Fill complete rows or columns to blast them clear and chain combos.

描述(中文): 璀璨宝石风方块宝石消除：拖拽闪耀宝石积木填满整行或整列瞬间粉碎，手感脆爽无限畅玩！
description(EN): Fit sparkling jewel polyominoes into an 8x8 board to shatter glowing lines and chain huge gemstone combos.
controls: Drag jewel shapes onto open grid slots to complete full rows or columns and rack up combos.

描述(中文): 极度舒适的 3D 立体七巧板拼块：把糖果色异形立体方块严丝合缝塞进几何托盘，强迫症看了直呼解压。
description(EN): Fit colorful 3D polyomino blocks snugly into sculpted geometric trays with zero gaps—rotate your thinking and lock every satisfying click into place.
controls: Drag 3D polyomino blocks from the dock into the puzzle frame so all pieces fill the tray completely with no overlaps.

描述(中文): 超治愈爆款三消花艺收纳：拖动玫瑰、向日葵、郁金香归类进同色花盆，三朵凑齐瞬间绽放消除超解压！
description(EN): Sort vibrant roses, sunflowers, and tulips across sunny wooden garden shelves—pair three identical blossoms in a pot to clear dazzling floral combos.
controls: Drag flowers from pot to pot to group three matching blossoms together and clear every shelf before the timer runs out.

描述(中文): 超治愈爆款奶茶店闯关冒险：调配波霸珍珠、芝士奶盖与缤纷果茶，手速爆表服务排队顾客解锁全套网红爆款配方！
description(EN): Mix chewy pearls, creamy milk tea, and colorful toppings across fast-paced beverage orders—serve eager customers and unlock trendy new boba recipes.
controls: Tap ingredients and cup stations to craft customer orders quickly and clear each lively shop stage.

描述(中文): 抖音魔性物理装瓶收纳挑战：看准水果尺寸和物理弹跳落点逐一投入玻璃瓶，完美塞满不溢出才算真高手！
description(EN): Drop bouncy fruits and clever physics shapes into quirky glass jars—pack every piece cleanly below the rim line without a single overflow.
controls: Tap or drag horizontally above the bottle mouth to position each item and drop it neatly inside the jar.

描述(中文): 3D 都市小队突围射击跑酷：左右滑屏穿越增益门扩充火力小队、升级武器，横扫沿途敌军与关底 Boss。
description(EN): Lead a 3D tactical squad down action-packed city streets, multiply troops through power gates, upgrade weapons, and blast through enemy barricades.
controls: Drag left and right to steer your squad through bonus gates and fire automatically at incoming enemies and bosses.

描述(中文): 硬核爽快 3D 射击激战突围：端起火力全开的武器冲破重重敌军包围，灵活走位点杀精英怪杀出一条血路！
description(EN): Hold the line against relentless waves of armored foes—upgrade tactical weapons, dodge incoming fire, and blast a path out of the encirclement.
controls: Drag to move and aim your trooper while automatically firing at nearby enemies and collecting power-ups.

描述(中文): 清新欢乐休闲浴室打水泡：瞄准升腾的七彩肥皂泡泡连发射击触发满屏爆裂，清脆解压一局接一局！
description(EN): Pop shimmering rainbow soap bubbles rising across a playful bathtub arena—chain sparkling bursts before bubbles float away.
controls: Aim and shoot bubbles into matching color groups to pop sparkling soapy chains.

描述(中文): 经典泡泡龙全面升级：拉线瞄准反弹发射六角晶莹泡泡，连爆三消引发整片雪崩掉落，轻松冲刺高分纪录。
description(EN): Aim, bounce bank shots off the walls, and pop dazzling hexagonal clusters of crystal bubbles with your trusty little dragon launcher.
controls: Drag to aim your dotted trajectory line (bank off side walls for trick shots) and release to launch colorful hex bubbles.

描述(中文): 魔性手速解压抓虫子 3D：眼疾手快精准捕捉满屏乱窜的搞笑小虫子，连击加分超上头，专治手残！
description(EN): Spot and snatch mischievous crawling bugs darting across vibrant 3D scenes—chain fast reflexes and clear every wave before the clock expires.
controls: Tap swiftly on scurrying bugs to catch them and hit each stage's target score before time runs out.

描述(中文): 精致横版卡通跑酷虫虫快跑：化身敏捷小甲虫在微观花园赛道极速冲刺，灵活二段跳越过沟壑与天敌冲向终点！
description(EN): Race across colorful garden leaves and forest branches as a speedy little beetle—leap pitfalls, dodge hungry predators, and blast through side-scrolling courses.
controls: Tap jump and action controls to leap over gaps, bounce off springs, and sprint to the finish line.

描述(中文): 满屏弹幕肉鸽割草射击：单手风骚走位自动狂射、升级进化超武大招，体验以一敌百横扫怪潮的极致爽感！
description(EN): Weave through endless monster swarms while your auto-firing arsenal evolves into screen-filling volleys, spinning blades, and explosive skills.
controls: Drag with one finger to dodge incoming enemy waves, gather XP gems, and choose roguelike weapon upgrades.

描述(中文): 抖音爆款颜色配对挪车接人：按队列乘客颜色依次调度对应颜色小巴驶出停车场，清空全部乘客爽感拉满！
description(EN): Clear gridlocked parking lanes and dispatch color-coded buses to pick up matching waiting passengers before every boarding bay fills up.
controls: Tap unblocked colored buses in the lot to send them to the pickup lane so matching passengers can board and depart.

描述(中文): 超治愈 ASMR 剪纽扣益智闯关：沿着直线一剪刀剪落成排同色纽扣，200 道巧思关卡一剪清空极度解压！
description(EN): Snip gleaming tailor shears along crisp straight lines of matching buttons across 200 tactile ASMR craft puzzles until the cloth is spotless.
controls: Swipe cleanly across two or more aligned buttons of the same color to snip them off the fabric board.

描述(中文): 沿着碧海阳光热带岛屿地图一路闯关，滑动消除缤纷糖果，合成条纹糖与彩虹炸弹引爆全屏特效。
description(EN): Journey across a sunlit tropical archipelago matching colorful candies, crafting striped and rainbow boosters, and clearing handcrafted island stages.
controls: Select a level on the island map, then swipe adjacent candies to match three or more and combine special boosters.

描述(中文): 高画质魔性走位躲避吃不到我呀：在满场追兵围堵下风骚蛇皮走位，诱敌互撞狂捡道具极限存活刷高分！
description(EN): Zigzag through frantic cartoon arenas dodging hungry chasers—lure pursuers into bumping each other and snag power-ups to survive as long as possible.
controls: Drag to weave swiftly around pursuing enemies, trigger traps, and collect bonus coins.

描述(中文): 爆火全网的挪车接人颜色排序！精准判断出车顺序，把堵满停车场的彩色小车开进候车位，接走对应颜色乘客清空全场。
description(EN): Untangle a packed parking lot of color-coded cars and buses—send each vehicle out in the right order to pick up matching passengers before the waiting bays fill up.
controls: Tap unblocked colored cars to drive them into the boarding bays and pick up matching-color passengers from the queue.

描述(中文): 经典烧脑华容道挪车神作：前后挪动挡路轿车与大巴腾出通道，用最少步数把红色主角车顺利开出拥堵停车场！
description(EN): Slide parked sedans, trucks, and buses along a cramped lot to carve out a clear exit lane for your red hero car in the fewest moves possible.
controls: Drag vehicles forward or backward along their lanes until the target car can drive straight through the exit.

描述(中文): 温馨益智轨道规划小火车货运：拨动道岔连接铁路轨道，护送满载货物的小火车平稳驶入终点车站！
description(EN): Switch railway junctions, lay smooth curved tracks, and guide cheerful steam locomotives safely to their matching station platforms.
controls: Tap track switches or tiles to route each locomotive cleanly into its color-matched station.

描述(中文): 拖动拉弓瞄准、松手投石，击倒木石城塔并清除全部守卫，每关三发，共四关。
description(EN): Launch three stones per stage, topple timber and stone towers and defeat every guard across four stages.
controls: Drag back and down from the sling to aim, then release. Defeat every guard with three stones per stage.

描述(中文): 抓大鹅同款 3D 物理堆叠找物三消：在满满一盆呆萌海洋生物中眼疾手快凑齐三连消除，限时冲击高星。
description(EN): Spot and collect three matching 3D sea creatures from a tumbling ocean heap before the timer expires, chaining quick matches for combo stars.
controls: Tap three matching 3D fish or marine toys to collect them into the bottom slots and clear every target before time runs out.

描述(中文): 微信畅玩榜现象级爆款抓大鹅 3D：在堆满立体萌物的 3D 大盆里眼疾手快挑出三个相同物品消除，清空全场抓住大鹅！
description(EN): Rummage through a bustling 3D pile of everyday props and farm items, match three identical objects in your tray, and clear the entire mountain to catch the elusive big goose.
controls: Tap 3D objects in the pile to send them into your bottom tray; match three identical items to clear them before the tray fills up.

描述(中文): 超萌抓大鹅同款堆叠找物三消：在满满一筐 Q 弹小猫与可爱杂货堆里眼疾手快揪出三个同款，配齐洗牌、回退与磁铁道具。
description(EN): Dive into a lively tumbling basket of cute kitties, toys, and treats—pluck matching trios into your tray before it fills up.
controls: Tap matching kitties and trinkets in the pile to collect three of a kind in your bottom slots; use booster props anytime.

描述(中文): 一整堆软萌小猪屁股、泰迪熊和玩具咕噜咕噜滚满屏幕！眼疾手快翻出三个一模一样的凑对消掉，倒计时嘀嗒作响，越抓越上头。
description(EN): A physics heap of plump pink piggies, teddy bears and colorful toys tumbles across the screen — snatch matching triples before the clock runs dry.
controls: Tap toys and piggies into your 7-slot tray to match triples. Hit Freeze, Auto-Match, or Pop-Out when the tray fills up.

描述(中文): 抖音爽文题材爆款职场逆袭：从底层打工人开局，精准抉择职场危机、投资创业一路打脸逆袭成为顶级商业霸总！
description(EN): Start from rock bottom and climb the corporate ladder—make sharp office choices, crush rival schemes, build business ventures, and rise into an unstoppable billionaire CEO.
controls: Tap choices, complete business tasks, and invest earnings to boost your career rank and wealth.

描述(中文): 烧脑华容道式密室推块消除：在狭小机关密室里巧挪异形彩块，对准边缘同色出口逐个粉碎清屏。
description(EN): Outsmart tight stone-chamber puzzles by sliding interlocking jewel blocks toward matching exits before the move counter runs out.
controls: Drag colored chamber blocks across the grid to match them with same-color perimeter exits and clear every tile.

描述(中文): 萌系横版策略战斗三国 Q 将：收集软萌三国 Q 版名将组成梦幻战队，华丽全屏合击大招一路横推群雄！
description(EN): Recruit adorable chibi heroes of Wei, Shu, and Wu—chain dazzling ultimate combos in breezy side-scrolling brawls packed with loot.
controls: Tap hero portraits when rage fills to unleash signature ultimates and push through each campaign stage.

描述(中文): 300 关海量轻解压消除合集：每一关都是精致清爽的几何逻辑谜题，顺着方向逐一弹出清空，随时随地放空大脑。
description(EN): Unwind with a huge collection of crisp tactile puzzle stages—slide directional blocks, untangle neat geometric paths, and pop clean clears at your own pace.
controls: Tap unobstructed arrows and pieces to clear the board step by step across hundreds of handcrafted stages.

描述(中文): 国民国粹经典单机中国象棋：随时随地离线开局楚河汉界博弈，车马炮步步为营挑战智能电脑棋手绝杀将死！
description(EN): Match wits against a built-in offline Xiangqi AI across classic wooden boards—command chariots, cannons, and knights to outflank the rival general and deliver checkmate.
controls: Tap any red piece to highlight valid moves across the board, then tap a target intersection to advance or capture.

描述(中文): 超治愈手绘风「二合 + 模拟经营」爆款：帮圆滚滚的小肥啾翻新温馨健身房，拖拽合成器材、解锁跑步机与花式瘦身设施。
description(EN): Renovate a cozy pastel fitness studio for adorable chubby chicks by merging workout gear, unlocking treadmills, and keeping every fluffy guest happy.
controls: Tap highlighted orders and merge matching items on the board to earn stars, renovate rooms, and unlock new bird gym equipment.

描述(中文): 魔性欢乐 3D 动作闯关胖奥的冒险：陪呆萌胖奥翻山越岭躲陷阱、拾金币打小怪，开启轻松解压的奇幻冒险之旅！
description(EN): Join plucky Chubby Hero on a lively 3D adventure packed with bouncy platforms, coin trails, and cheeky monsters guarding every milestone.
controls: Drag or swipe to steer, jump across moving platforms, collect coins, and clear each adventure stage.

描述(中文): 轻松治愈的经典拼图体验：拖动精美插画碎片对准凹凸接口咔哒拼合，一步步还原完整高清大图。
description(EN): Unwind with crisp interlocking jigsaw puzzles—drag curved pieces across the table, snap matching edges together, and reveal vibrant full-screen illustrations.
controls: Drag scattered jigsaw pieces onto their matching positions on the board; correctly placed neighbors lock together smoothly.

描述(中文): 永恒逻辑益智神作经典推箱子：在精巧仓库迷宫中步步规划，别把箱子推进死角，全部推上标记点即通关！
description(EN): Think three moves ahead inside tight warehouse mazes—push every wooden crate cleanly onto its glowing floor target without trapping a single box.
controls: Swipe or tap directional controls to walk and push crates onto every designated goal tile.

描述(中文): 全民脑力锻炼经典数独：清爽护眼 9x9 棋盘配智能笔记与多档难度，随时随地静心推理填满数字超解压！
description(EN): Sharpen your logic across crisp 9x9 Sudoku grids with clean pencil notes, instant conflict checks, and multiple difficulty tiers from breezy to expert.
controls: Tap an empty cell and select digits 1–9 so every row, column, and 3x3 box contains each number once.

描述(中文): 极简魔性一指跑酷峭壁极限逃亡：在悬崖峭壁窄道间极速疾驰，看准拐角精准点击转向跳跃绝不掉崖！
description(EN): Leap across crumbling canyon cliffs and narrow stone ledges—one crisp tap turns corners and jumps chasms in high-stakes endless running.
controls: Tap at exact corners and gaps to turn or leap safely along the winding cliff path.

描述(中文): 清新治愈浮云 2048 消消乐：在蓝天白云间落下数字云朵触发连锁合成升级，轻松合出 2048 超级减压！
description(EN): Drop fluffy sky-blue number tiles onto dreamy cloud columns—chain cascading 2048 merges in a soothing, ultra-smooth arcade puzzler.
controls: Tap a column to drop the active number tile onto matching numbers and chain higher merges.

描述(中文): 全球亿级极简神作色彩跳跃 Color Switch：轻点跳跃只穿同色旋转色环，节奏精准魔性到停不下来！
description(EN): Tap to bounce a glowing ball upward and pass cleanly ONLY through segments matching your current neon color—one mistake shatters everything!
controls: Tap to hop upward through rotating color wheels matching your ball's hue while collecting stars.

描述(中文): 超上头逆袭养成模拟逆袭大冒险：从小摊打工逆天改命，解锁奇趣副业、买车买房打脸势利眼，爽感直接拉满！
description(EN): Battle poverty and bad luck through witty mini-challenges, side hustles, and smart investments until you flip your destiny into ultimate success.
controls: Tap work tasks, upgrade skills, and make bold life decisions to grow your wealth and status.

描述(中文): 守护星空中发光的轨道空间站。驾驶拦截机击碎熔岩彗星，撑过一波比一波猛的攻势。
description(EN): Defend a luminous orbital station in a painted starfield. Fly an interceptor, shatter molten comets and survive escalating waves.
controls: WASD / arrows move · mouse aim + hold click fire · Space auto-aim + fire · touch drag to fly + auto-fire · P / Esc pause · R restart

描述(中文): 萌翻全场的治愈系冲吧柯基小狗：操控圆屁股小柯基一路撒欢奔跑、越过障碍叼骨头，开心减压一整天！
description(EN): Dash down sunny park paths with an adorable short-legged Corgi—leap puddles, grab tasty bone treats, and sprint for cheerful endless scores.
controls: Tap or swipe to dodge obstacles, leap hurdles, and scoop up bones along the park lane.

描述(中文): 魔性爆笑 3D 街头打群架：四处招兵买马壮大你的小弟军团，见人就干以多打少横扫全场成为街头最强老大！
description(EN): Recruit a growing gang across chaotic urban arenas, outnumber rival squads, smash into brawls with hilarious physics, and dominate the entire street map.
controls: Drag on screen to steer your squad around the arena, absorb neutral fighters, and overwhelm smaller enemy groups.

描述(中文): 超爽 3D 人海冲锋跑酷：左右滑动挑选最大倍率增益门，避开旋转机关，带着满屏小弟一路推平终极城堡。
description(EN): Lead a growing 3D squad down sky-high obstacle tracks, choosing the highest multiplier gates to storm rival forces and smash the fortress.
controls: Drag left and right to steer your crowd through multiplier gates, dodge traps, and overwhelm enemy squads.

描述(中文): 爆款物理弹射合成 2048：拉线发射 Q 弹 3D 数字方块，碰撞相同数字触发连环弹跳合成暴击，根本停不下来！
description(EN): Aim and fire bouncing 3D numbered cubes down a physics runway—collide matching blocks to trigger bouncy chain-reaction merges all the way past 2048.
controls: Hold and drag horizontally to aim your cube along the lane, then release to launch it into matching numbered cubes.

描述(中文): 国民级物理益智割绳子：算准摆动时机一刀划断绳索，借力收集沿途金星，把糖果稳稳送进小怪兽嘴里。
description(EN): Time every physics rope slice to swing the striped candy through floating golden stars and drop it straight into your hungry little monster’s mouth.
controls: Swipe across taut ropes to slice them cleanly, collect floating stars along the swing arc, and feed the candy to the monster.

描述(中文): 全网刷屏解压神器电子木鱼：轻轻一敲功德 +1 清脆音效瞬间抚平焦虑，支持切换多种木鱼皮肤与自动敲击模式！
description(EN): Tap the resonant digital wooden fish for instant zen merit +1 pops, switch soothing mallet tones and skins, or enable auto-chanting mode to unwind.
controls: Tap the wooden fish to rack up merit points, customize themes and text popups, or toggle auto-tap.

描述(中文): 超爽 3D 街机极速狂飙：单手滑动变道踩满氮气加速带，贴身超车甩开对手，合成解锁更猛超跑冲刺冠军！
description(EN): Weave through sunlit 3D street courses, hit glowing turbo boost pads, merge and upgrade sleek sports cars, and leave rival racers in your slipstream.
controls: Hold and drag left or right to steer across lanes, hit boost pads, dodge traffic, and sprint to first place.

描述(中文): 经典全民解压三消天天消一消：指尖轻划触发全屏彩虹连锁爆破，音效清脆手感丝滑，随时来一局根本停不下来！
description(EN): Pop glossy candies and colorful blocks in snappy match-3 rounds—unleash rainbow cascades and rack up huge combo multipliers across relaxing stages.
controls: Swap adjacent tiles to align three or more of the same color and clear every level objective.

描述(中文): 爆笑热梗知识闯关天天么么答：网罗网络热梗与趣味百科脑洞题库，限时抢答连对飙分，越答越上头！
description(EN): Test your pop-culture wits and rapid-fire trivia knowledge across hilarious themed quiz rounds packed with internet memes and surprising brain-teasers.
controls: Read each witty question and tap the correct answer choice before the round timer expires.

描述(中文): 3D 史前恐龙岛模拟经营：探索神秘大陆、孵化呆萌恐龙、采集资源扩建园区，亲手打造人山人海的侏罗纪乐园！
description(EN): Explore a vibrant 3D prehistoric island, hatch adorable dinosaurs, gather resources, unlock new enclosures, and expand your bustling Jurassic park empire.
controls: Drag the virtual joystick to move your explorer around the island, harvest resources, and step onto unlock pads to build dinosaur habitats.

描述(中文): 超爽 3D 恐龙合成进化对战：拖拽两只相同恐龙合体进化成霸王龙与远古巨兽，排兵布阵碾压对面军团！
description(EN): Fuse matching dinosaurs on your tactical battlefield to evolve fierce T-Rexes and armored beasts, then unleash your prehistoric squad in explosive auto-battles.
controls: Drag identical dinosaurs together on the grid to merge stronger tiers, then tap Fight to start the battle.

描述(中文): 抖音爆火解压 3D 医生模拟：化身全能急诊大夫，用镊子听诊器与药水逐一治愈奇葩病例，强迫症看了极度舒适！
description(EN): Step into the ER as a hands-on clinic doctor—diagnose quirky symptoms, apply bandages and treatments with satisfying 3D tools, and send every patient home smiling.
controls: Drag medical instruments onto highlighted treatment spots and follow on-screen prompts to heal each patient.

描述(中文): 紧张刺激末日求生大逃生：在危机四伏的废土街道一路突围，开火清怪营救幸存者冲向安全区！
description(EN): Sprint through crumbling apocalyptic streets—blast zombies blocking your path, rescue survivors, and reach the extraction chopper.
controls: Drag to steer your survivor squad, shoot approaching threats, and gather ammo boosts.

描述(中文): 高爽感单手肉鸽清屏割草：虚拟摇杆走位躲避尸潮，自动释放进化武器、清屏炸弹与吸铁石，满屏收割超解压。
description(EN): Weave through swarms of urban zombies with one-finger joystick movement, auto-firing evolving weapons, bombs, and magnets in intense roguelite survival.
controls: Drag anywhere on screen to move your agent with the virtual joystick; weapons fire automatically while you dodge swarms and pick level-up skills.

描述(中文): 超爽末日尸潮割草防线：端枪走位扫射满屏僵尸、捡钞票建自动炮台、解锁火力升级，在尸潮围攻下守住公路据点！
description(EN): Hold the highway barricade against relentless zombie waves—collect loot, unlock automated gun turrets, expand your safe zone, and blast through escalating hordes.
controls: Drag on screen with the virtual joystick to move your survivor, auto-fire at approaching zombies, gather cash drops, and step onto pads to build turrets and upgrades.

描述(中文): 魔性烧脑路径规划画线迷宫：为多位角色分别画出通往终点的路线，绕开墙壁障碍且绝不撞车，一气呵成超解压！
description(EN): Trace non-crossing paths connecting every character to their matching goal without collisions—a snappy spatial rush-to-goal brain-teaser.
controls: Drag from each character to their matching destination icon while avoiding obstacles and mid-path collisions.

描述(中文): 经典时间管理爆款梦幻厨房：煎烤烹炸手速飞起，精准上菜赚取连击小费，升级厨具解锁世界各地人气美食餐厅！
description(EN): Fire up the grill in a lively gourmet restaurant—plate sizzling dishes, chain fast combo tips, upgrade kitchen appliances, and unlock global culinary themes.
controls: Tap raw ingredients to cook, plate finished meals, and serve hungry guests before their patience bars run low.

描述(中文): 在复古竖屏赛道自动前进，按住左右侧漂移，松手回正，三圈内击败三辆AI赛车。
description(EN): Drift through a scrolling retro circuit and beat three AI rivals across three laps.
controls: Hold the left or right side to drift that way; release to straighten. Stay on the road and finish three laps first.

描述(中文): 魔性一指挂钩甩尾漂移赛车：入弯长按贴弯极限漂移、出弯松手全速冲刺，升级爱车刷爆赛道连击纪录！
description(EN): Hold through tight winding asphalt curves to sling your race car into buttery one-thumb drifts, rack up lap combos, and upgrade faster rides.
controls: Press and hold on screen to hook into corners and drift smoothly; release on straightaways to rocket ahead.

描述(中文): 魔性左右脑互搏挑战双手极速赛车：同时操控红蓝两辆跑车在四车道狂飙，吃金币躲路障，极度考验反应力！
description(EN): Command two speeding sports cars simultaneously on parallel neon highways—dodge roadblocks and scoop every fuel circle in an intense split-brain reflex test.
controls: Tap the left half to switch the left car's lane and tap the right half to switch the right car's lane.

描述(中文): 爆笑魔性竞技最强鸭王：武装你的战斗鸭一路过关斩将、爆锤奇葩对手鸭，霸气登顶池塘最强鸭王宝座！
description(EN): Waddle into a hilarious cartoon showdown—train, gear up, and battle quirky rival ducks to claim the golden crown of the pond.
controls: Tap action buttons and upgrades to train your duck fighter and defeat every challenger.

描述(中文): 复古横版动作闯关鸭子杜克大冒险：操控勇敢的杜克小鸭跳跃踩怪、跨越险峻平台与尖刺机关，通关寻宝乐趣无穷！
description(EN): Waddle, jump, and dash across charming retro side-scrolling stages as Duke the fearless duck—stomp quirky foes, dodge spikes, and claim sparkling treasure.
controls: Use left/right movement and jump buttons (or arrow keys / spacebar) to navigate platforms and defeat enemies.

描述(中文): 暗黑像素肉鸽割草逃出地下城：孤身勇闯怪物狂潮地牢，拾取经验升级叠满超武神技，杀出血路逃出生天！
description(EN): Battle through dark crypts swarming with skeletons and slimes—stack roguelike skill combos, evolve devastating weapons, and fight your way out of the dungeon.
controls: Drag to dodge monster packs while auto-firing spells and selecting roguelike skill upgrades on level-up.

描述(中文): 抖音爆款眼力找茬神作我眼力超强：在满屏细节的魔性插画里揪出穿越穿帮与离谱隐藏彩蛋，专治大意眼花！
description(EN): Zoom your detective eyes across busy comic scenes to catch sneaky time-travel bloopers, hidden Easter eggs, and absurd details before time runs out.
controls: Scan the illustrated scene carefully and tap every suspicious or out-of-place detail to complete the checklist.

描述(中文): 现象级魔性经商模拟挣他一个亿：低买高卖倒腾爆款商品、抓准市场行情投资开公司，立个小目标先挣他一个亿！
description(EN): Start with pocket change and hunt market bargains—buy low, sell high across quirky commodities, invest in booming industries, and race to hit your first 100 million.
controls: Tap market listings to buy undervalued goods, advance days to watch prices swing, and invest profits into businesses.

描述(中文): 经典国王密室营救消除玩法：在机关重重的地牢里连消宝石破除尖刺陷阱，争分夺秒救出被困国王。
description(EN): Match glowing gems and blast obstacles to rescue the stranded young king from dungeon spike traps across escalating puzzle chambers.
controls: Tap or swap matching blocks to trigger combos, clear chamber hazards, and rescue the king before moves run out.

描述(中文): 清新田园风三消农场消消消：滑动交换饱满果蔬触发丰收连锁爆破，解锁特效道具完成每日农场订单！
description(EN): Swap ripe carrots, pumpkins, and sunny apples across idyllic countryside grids—unleash harvest boosters to complete every cozy farm goal.
controls: Swap adjacent crops to match three or more in a line and collect all target farm harvests.

描述(中文): 超上头的彩色区域逻辑推理棋盘：每种颜色区域、每行、每列有且仅有 1 只目标且互不相邻，步步排除越玩越停不下来！
description(EN): Solve clever color-region logic grid puzzles inspired by viral Queens brain teasers—place exactly one cheeky creature in every row, column, and colored zone with no two touching.
controls: Tap grid squares to mark empty cells or place a creature so every row, column, and colored region holds exactly one without touching diagonally or orthogonally.

描述(中文): 童年封神双人解谜红蓝最强搭档：灵活切换冰火双角色互踩机关、避开相克池水收集宝石，默契配合闯关！
description(EN): Switch seamlessly between Fire and Water heroes to trigger color levers, cross opposing pools safely, and unlock temple exit doors together.
controls: Move, jump, and switch between the red and blue characters to solve switches and reach both temple doors.

描述(中文): 微信爆款模拟经营五星卫生院：把小小社区卫生站一步步扩建成五星医院，招募神医、扩建科室治病赚钱爽翻天！
description(EN): Turn a humble neighborhood clinic into a bustling five-star medical center—hire quirky doctors, unlock specialty wards, cure hilarious patients, and watch profits soar.
controls: Tap to build departments, upgrade medical beds, hire staff, and collect consultation earnings from cured patients.

描述(中文): 寓教于乐爆款文字游戏纠正错别字：化身毒舌语文老师批改奇葩作文与招牌，一眼揪出隐藏错别字超有成就感！
description(EN): Play sharp-eyed proofreader across witty essays, signs, and notes—spot sneaky homophone typos and swap in the right Chinese characters.
controls: Scan the text passage and tap every misspelled character to mark and fix all typos in the level.

描述(中文): 现象级魔性手残测试像素鸟 Flappy Bird：轻轻一点扇动翅膀穿过绿色水管缝隙，简单到一秒上手却让人狂飙胜负欲！
description(EN): Tap with split-second rhythm to flap a plump pixel bird between endless green warp pipes—simple to start, impossibly addictive to master.
controls: Tap anywhere on screen (or press Space) to flap upward and thread cleanly through every pipe gap.

描述(中文): 经典全民休闲水果泡泡龙：拉线借助墙壁反弹精准射出彩色水果泡泡，打断顶部支点整片掉落爽翻天！
description(EN): Bank crisp shots off side walls to pop vibrant clusters of glossy fruit bubbles—drop whole hanging sections at once for juicy cascade scores.
controls: Drag to aim the dotted bounce guide and release to shoot fruit bubbles into matching color clusters.

描述(中文): 复古暖纸手绘风模拟经营小游戏：点按或拖拽可爱水果上器械撸铁暴汗、派店长递水拍醒偷懒牛油果、收金币雇员工扩店，闯过 7 大主题日。
description(EN): Run a bustling retro gym for adorable fruits: drag members onto workout gear, sprint to serve water or wake up sleepy avocados, collect sweat coins, and expand across 7 themed days.
controls: Tap or drag waiting fruits onto gym stations, tap service bubbles to assist or wake slackers, tap coins to collect and sweat puddles to mop, and use Upgrade or Fever Bell.

描述(中文): 国民经典益智水果连连看：眼疾手快连接两个相同水果且拐弯不超过两次即可闪电消除，清爽脆甜越玩越上头！
description(EN): Connect juicy pairs of strawberries, lemons, and kiwis using paths with at most two turns—race the clock to clear bright orchard boards.
controls: Tap two matching fruit tiles that can connect with a clear path of up to three straight segments.

描述(中文): 经典爆汁街机切水果狂潮：手起刀落一刀连切西瓜菠萝满屏飙汁，灵巧避开突袭炸弹刷新极限连击得分！
description(EN): Swipe across flying watermelons, pineapples, and citrus in crisp arcade slicing combos—trigger multi-fruit juicy bursts while dodging sudden bombs.
controls: Press and drag rapidly across the screen to slice airborne fruits into combos while avoiding black bombs.

描述(中文): 爆款三消叠加装修玩法花园装修家：在层叠牌堆中收集三个相同图案消除攒星，亲手打造鸟语花香的私家大花园！
description(EN): Clear layered garden tile stacks in classic triple-match style to earn renovation stars and turn an overgrown estate into a blooming paradise.
controls: Tap uncovered tiles to place them into the tray; match three identical icons to clear them and earn garden stars.

描述(中文): 拖动军团选择算术门，壮大队伍，在终点击败敌军。
description(EN): Lead your squad through arithmetic gates and defeat the final army.
controls: Drag left and right to choose gates.

描述(中文): 全球超休闲亿级爆款奔跑吧巨人：赛道吃同色小人疯狂变大变强，撞碎障碍一路狂飙到终点一拳打飞大 Boss！
description(EN): Sprint down vibrant 3D obstacle lanes, collect same-colored stickmen to bulk up into a towering colossus, smash through brick walls, and KO the rival boss at the finish.
controls: Drag left and right to steer your runner through matching color crowds, dodge hazards, and tap rapidly in the final boss clash.

描述(中文): 在月色下交换花朵，凑齐三朵触发消除，让连锁绽放唤醒沉睡的魔法花园。24 步内获得 2200 分即可通关。
description(EN): Trade petals. Trigger cascading blooms. Reach 2,200 points in 24 moves to wake the forgotten moon garden.
controls: Click two adjacent blooms or swipe to swap · arrows select, Space / Enter confirm · P / Esc pause · R restart

描述(中文): 国民级经典回忆杀：瞄准摆动的矿工铁爪抓起大金块、闪亮钻石与神秘钱袋，活用炸药与关间商店道具冲击高分。
description(EN): Time your swinging brass claw to haul up giant gold nuggets, sparkling diamonds, and mystery sacks before the clock runs out across handcrafted underground mines.
controls: Click, tap, or press Space/Down to launch the swinging claw. Press E or click Dynamite while reeling in heavy rocks to blast them away.

描述(中文): 国民经典对弈 AI 五子棋：离线随时迎战智能电脑棋手，步步布阵活三冲四抢先连成五子一举定胜负！
description(EN): Challenge a sharp offline Five-in-a-Row AI on a warm wooden Go board—set clever double-three traps, block threats, and connect five stones first.
controls: Tap any empty grid intersection on the board to place your stone and connect five in a row horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.

描述(中文): 海内外爆款货架整理三消：在琳琅满目的多层货柜中挪动零食、饮品与潮玩，凑齐三个同款连击清空整排货架。
description(EN): Organize bustling boutique supermarket shelves by dragging snacks, drinks, and plushies into neat matching trios before the clock winds down.
controls: Drag goods between shelf slots to line up three identical items on the same shelf and clear them in combos.

描述(中文): 魔性搞笑卡通塔防：在弯道沿线排满脑洞炮塔与奇葩机关，花式升级打得蠢萌怪兽满天乱飞！
description(EN): Place wacky cartoon turrets along winding lanes and unleash absurdly powerful combos to send waves of goofy invaders flying.
controls: Tap lane slots to deploy and upgrade quirky defense towers, merge firepower, and trigger special skills against incoming waves.

描述(中文): 魔性搞笑手速小游戏夹个包子：盯紧热气腾腾的蒸笼，看准时机出筷精准夹起美味大肉包，连夹暴击超欢乐！
description(EN): Time your wooden chopsticks with razor precision to snatch steaming baozi dumplings off a rotating steamer before the timer runs out.
controls: Tap at the right moment to snap your chopsticks closed and pick up passing steamed buns for bonus streaks.

描述(中文): 魔性搞笑横版射击枪弹雄鸡：给暴躁大公鸡配上重机枪横冲直撞，跳台狂射奇葩小怪笑点密集爽感十足！
description(EN): Strap an oversized blaster onto a fearless cartoon rooster and storm wacky platform stages—blast goofy baddies, leap hazards, and collect golden feathers.
controls: Use move, jump, and fire controls to blast through side-scrolling stages as the heroic rooster.

描述(中文): 微信热榜超火打螺丝玩了个锤子：拆下螺丝挪进空洞，让层层卡住的木板铁片哗啦啦全部掉落，极度上头解压！
description(EN): Unscrew bolts from overlapping steel plates and wooden boards in exact sequence so every heavy plank tumbles cleanly off the wall.
controls: Tap a screw to pick it up, then tap an open hole to relocate it until all boards drop free.

描述(中文): 抖音全民爆火汉字脑洞找茬：拆字寻宝、看图找梗、文字谐音脑洞大开，每一关都让人拍案叫绝！
description(EN): Dissect Chinese characters, spot hilarious visual puns, and solve clever wordplay stages inspired by viral Hanzi brain-teaser hits.
controls: Tap strokes, radicals, or hidden scene clues to solve each clever Chinese character riddle.

描述(中文): 国风手绘水墨脑洞汉字闯关：拆字组字、爆笑热梗找茬、反转谜题一关接一关停不下来。
description(EN): Explore witty Chinese-character brain teasers and ink-wash puzzle stages where every stroke, radical, and pun unlocks a surprising solution.
controls: Tap, drag, or combine Chinese characters and scene objects to solve each brain-teaser stage.

描述(中文): 全球亿级下载经典物理画线欢乐水杯：用一支铅笔自由画线搭建导流槽，把清水精准引入空水杯让它开心大笑，画得越短星级越高！
description(EN): Sketch clever physics bridges and funnels with a single pencil stroke to channel rushing water into an empty smiling glass for three-star perfection.
controls: Press and drag to draw solid pencil lines that guide falling water smoothly into the cup up to the dotted fill line.

描述(中文): 手绘风 3D 第一人称射击，战场是一座弯曲的小岛。跑酷、二段跳、滑铲、冲刺、钩索全都有，守住海风港，打退兔子大军。
description(EN): A hand-drawn 3D first-person shooter on a tiny curved island. Run, double jump, slide, dash and grapple across Seabreeze Harbor while you fend off the rabbit invasion.
controls: WASD move · mouse look · click fire · Space jump / double jump · Shift dash · Ctrl / C slide · E grapple · Esc pause · touch controls on phones

描述(中文): 超上头躺平发育宿舍塔防：开局狂奔进宿舍躺床发育、疯狂升级铁门与满屋炮塔，硬扛猛鬼猛砸宿舍门反杀通关！
description(EN): Dash into an empty dorm room, hop into bed to farm coins, reinforce your steel door, and build rapid-fire turrets before the prowling ghost breaks in.
controls: Drag to run into a dorm room and climb into bed, then tap empty floor tiles to construct and upgrade doors, generators, and turrets.

描述(中文): 高燃中世纪城门塔防守卫：指挥英勇骑士与箭塔军团正面迎敌，每波三选一狂叠肉鸽大招守住最后防线！
description(EN): Command heroic castle defenders and stack roguelike skill cards to crush waves of raiding monsters storming your fortress gate.
controls: Tap skill upgrades, build defensive fortifications, and guide your hero to defend the fortress against escalating enemy waves.

描述(中文): 买量顶流数字战力策略勇者爬塔：精算每层怪物战力，拖动勇者先吃弱怪疯狂叠加战力数值，一路横扫屠龙登顶！
description(EN): Outcalculate every floor in viral number-battle tower puzzles—drag your knight to defeat weaker monsters, absorb their power, and slay the top boss.
controls: Drag your hero into enemy rooms with lower power numbers to absorb their strength and clear the entire tower.

描述(中文): 经典奇幻战棋策略英雄无敌：招募骑士、法师与传奇魔兽组建军团，运筹帷幄克敌制胜称霸魔幻大陆！
description(EN): Assemble fantasy legions of paladins, griffins, and spellcasters—outflank enemy armies across classic hex-style tactical skirmishes.
controls: Arrange troop formations, tap skills and targets during combat, and upgrade your army between battles.

描述(中文): 烧脑解压蜂巢消除六边形消除：拖动多彩六边形拼块填满任意方向一整条直线瞬间清屏，手感丝滑无比！
description(EN): Fit jewel-like hexagonal block clusters onto a honeycomb board to wipe complete lines in three directions and ignite blazing combo streaks.
controls: Drag hexagonal shapes from the tray onto open cells to complete full lines across any of the three axes.

描述(中文): 魔性街机蓄力投篮挑战：按住精准把控力度条、松手拉出完美弧线空心入网，连进触发超高分狂热手感！
description(EN): Step onto the hardwood, charge your power gauge with perfect timing, and sink swish after swish for blazing arcade basketball streaks.
controls: Press and hold to charge the shot power bar, then release inside the sweet spot to swish the basketball through the hoop.

描述(中文): 魔性爆笑物理大炮发射对决：瞄准角度把整队小兵连发轰向敌阵、穿越倍增门轰塌堡垒，火力全开爽到飞起！
description(EN): Aim oversized cartoon cannons and fire ragdoll troopers through explosive barricades, bonus multiplier gates, and comical fortress towers.
controls: Hold and drag to aim your cannon angle and power, then fire waves of troopers to smash enemy defenses.

描述(中文): 国风益智经典成语接龙：首尾相连填词闯关，海量成语题库层层解锁，休闲涨知识两不误！
description(EN): Link timeless four-character Chinese idioms head-to-tail across crisp ink-paper stages—relaxing wordplay that boosts vocabulary effortlessly.
controls: Tap candidate characters to complete intersecting four-character idiom chains.

描述(中文): 武侠风长青益智成语大侠 202 关：202 关海量交叉成语填字挑战，闯关涨功力解锁江湖大侠称号！
description(EN): Master 202 handcrafted Chinese idiom crosswords with a breezy martial-arts theme—fill every intersecting phrase to level up your Jianghu title.
controls: Tap a blank square and choose the matching Chinese character to complete all intersecting idioms.

描述(中文): 超上头模拟经营放置大老板：开连锁店铺、雇佣金牌店长自动收钱，挂机躺赢一路买楼扩产变身亿万大老板！
description(EN): Grow a sprawling business empire with effortless idle taps—open shops, hire managers to automate cash flow, and scale from street vendor to billionaire tycoon.
controls: Tap to launch businesses, upgrade storefronts, hire managers, and collect booming cash stacks.

描述(中文): 国风古韵爆款宫廷合成：拖拽相同古风角色一路合体晋升，从秀女宫女一步步封后掌权，解锁绝美华服图鉴！
description(EN): Merge charming court characters from humble palace maid all the way to Empress—collect royal tribute coins and unlock gorgeous ancient costumes.
controls: Tap to summon attendants and drag two matching ranks together to merge and advance up the imperial hierarchy.

描述(中文): 爽快割草感策略塔防无敌：合理搭配冰冻减速与范围爆破炮塔，卡准路口火力交叉覆盖，怪潮寸步难行！
description(EN): Command an unstoppable line of elemental towers across tactical chokepoints—chain slow fields with AoE blasts to obliterate massive enemy rushes.
controls: Tap map nodes to build and upgrade towers, manage gold wisely, and unleash hero skills on tough waves.

描述(中文): 水墨风《水浒传》武松打虎。看清猛虎扑、掀、剪的起手，闪到安全的位置，趁它落空时连拳打虎。
description(EN): Wu Song meets the white-browed tiger on Jingyang Ridge, painted in ink wash. Read the pounce, swipe and tail-sweep tells, dodge into a safe lane and punish the tiger while it recovers.
controls: Left / Right or A / D dodge · Space / J / click strike · touch buttons on phones · P / Esc pause · R restart

描述(中文): 国风成语升官爆款请老爷断案：填字连成语步步查明奇案真相，升官发财买豪宅，玩着就把成语库刷满！
description(EN): Preside over an ancient magistrate courtroom—link intersecting Chinese idioms to uncover evidence, interrogate culprits, and earn promotions.
controls: Tap character tiles at the bottom to fill blanks on the idiom grid and advance through courtroom cases.

描述(中文): 国民经典一指蓄力跳跃：长按蓄力、松手精准飞跃落到下一个方块中心，连续正中靶心狂飙翻倍连击高分！
description(EN): Hold to charge your leap and release to land squarely on the next floating 3D pillar—chain bullseye center landings for skyrocketing combo multipliers.
controls: Press and hold anywhere on screen to charge your jump power, then release at the exact moment to hop onto the center of the next block.

描述(中文): 闯进新海诚风蔚蓝海湾！展开光翼掠过海上电车与红鸟居山坡，自由滑翔冲刺，还能一键触发平行世界破坏与时光倒流。
description(EN): Spread glowing sky-wings over a sunlit anime seaside bay! Glide beside the ocean tram, dive past shrine torii gates, shatter parallel worlds, and rewind time on a whim.
controls: WASD roam, F spread wings & fly, E ride the ocean tram, Tab shatter parallel worlds, Mouse look.

描述(中文): 经典强迫症爽游王者打砖块：找准死角把几十颗弹球送上砖块上方疯狂连弹，清脆碎砖音效超级治愈！
description(EN): Master precision bank shots across hundreds of geometric brick fortresses—chain 50+ bouncing balls behind the top wall for pure visual bliss.
controls: Drag to aim your launch trajectory and release to fire a stream of balls that chip down numbered bricks.

描述(中文): 软萌猫咪主题滑块拼图：挪动圆滚滚的猫咪积木块腾出通路，把每只小猫顺利送进对应的彩色出口。
description(EN): Slide plump cat-shaped polyomino blocks across cozy puzzle boards to clear pathways and match every kitty with its exit.
controls: Drag cat blocks horizontally or vertically to untangle the grid and guide each kitty to its matching color gate.

描述(中文): 软萌治愈系 3D 猫咪堆叠三消：在满满一桌胖嘟嘟小猫与猫玩具里揪出三只同款配对消除，萌化强迫症。
description(EN): Dig through an adorable pastel pile of chubby 3D kittens and cozy cat toys, picking three matching cuties at a time to clear every level.
controls: Tap matching 3D cat figures and toys to collect triplets into the bottom dock before it fills up.

描述(中文): 超治愈猫咪美食经营小店：和胖乎乎的猫咪大厨一起制作热气腾腾的特色小吃，招待可爱的猫猫客人，升级菜单装修人气夜宵摊。
description(EN): Manage a cozy street-side snack shop staffed by adorable cat chefs—cook tasty treats, serve impatient kitten guests, upgrade stalls, and unlock fresh recipes.
controls: Tap orders, cooking stations, and upgrade buttons to serve adorable cat customers and grow your cozy snack bar.

描述(中文): 国民级魔性见缝插针甩飞刀：看准旋转木桩的缝隙一键连射飞刀、切爆苹果、干碎强力 Boss 轮盘根本停不下来！
description(EN): Sink gleaming throwing knives into spinning wooden targets and boss wheels—thread tight gaps, slice bonus apples, and never hit another blade.
controls: Tap anywhere to fling a knife straight up into the rotating target without colliding with embedded blades.

描述(中文): 脑洞爆笑创意爆款织个 98K：一针一线亲手织出从弹弓到 98K 狙击枪的奇葩神兵，上靶场实弹开火笑料百出！
description(EN): Merge yarn, craft outrageous handmade weapons from slingshots to sniper 98Ks, and put your quirky creations to the test on the firing range.
controls: Tap to weave weapon parts, assemble upgrades, and aim on the range to blast mission targets.

描述(中文): 抖音爆火解压拆毛线闯关：按颜色顺序一根根抽丝剥茧拆掉毛线织物，卷满同色线轴一秒强迫症狂喜！
description(EN): Unravel chunky woven yarn models strand by strand—match spool colors cleanly to untangle every vibrant thread in ultra-satisfying puzzle levels.
controls: Tap colored yarn pins and spools in the right sequence to unravel matching wool layers without jamming the holding slots.

描述(中文): 拖动自动炮台瞄准，拾取升级卡三选一，撑过十波敌军。
description(EN): Aim an automatic turret, collect upgrade cards and survive ten waves.
controls: Drag to aim. Tap one of three upgrade cards.

描述(中文): 带着围巾的像素小狐狸在月光屋顶上奔跑。二段跳越过缺口，收集发光的纸灯笼，夜跑没有尽头。
description(EN): Guide a scarf-wearing pixel fox across layered moonlit rooftops. Double-jump the gaps and gather glowing paper lanterns in an endless night run.
controls: Space / Up / W / click / tap jump · hold for height · jump again in air · P / Esc pause · R restart

描述(中文): 在废弃的黑木学校里，手电熄灭前找到三把钥匙。用光束逼退追来的暗影，补充电量，打开东侧出口。
description(EN): Search the abandoned Blackwood school for three keys before your torch fades. Keep the pursuing shade in your beam, replenish your light and unlock the east exit.
controls: WASD / arrows to move; mouse to aim. Hold the mouse or drag on touch to walk toward the pointer. Enter / Space to start. P / Escape to pause. R to restart.

描述(中文): 萌系 3D 治愈系懒猫跑酷：操控胖橘猫在阳光街区和屋顶飞奔跳跃、一路狂吃小鱼干躲避障碍刷新最高分！
description(EN): Guide a chubby orange tabby sprinting across sunny rooftops and city lanes—leap over hurdles, snack on fish treats, and chase nonstop high scores.
controls: Swipe left, right, up, or down to switch lanes, jump over barriers, and slide under obstacles.

描述(中文): 国民级爆火文字模拟神作：随机十连抽逆天天赋、自由分配颜值智力体质家境，一键重开解锁暴富修仙等百种奇葩结局！
description(EN): Roll wild starting talents, allocate your core attributes, and tap through hilarious year-by-year life twists from humble beginnings to billionaire mogul or cosmic legend.
controls: Tap to draw random talents, assign your starting stats (Charm, Intelligence, Physique, Wealth), and click through each year of your unpredictable life.

描述(中文): 独自守住灯塔，熬过七个风暴之夜。分配最后的燃料，回应海上的求救；你的选择将决定谁能活着等到黎明。
description(EN): Keep a lighthouse alive through seven stormy nights. Spend the last fuel, answer impossible calls and decide whose names will make it into the morning log.
controls: Mouse / touch: select a choice · 1–3 choose · Enter continues · Read each consequence before deciding. Your supplies and earlier rescues change later outcomes. · P / Esc pause · R restart

描述(中文): 抖音曾经刷屏全网的口红机见缝插针：瞅准转盘空档连射口红，连闯三关稳稳不碰刀直接带走大奖！
description(EN): Fire glossy lipsticks into a spinning beauty wheel without clipping another tube—nail three escalating rounds to win the glamorous grand prize.
controls: Tap anywhere to shoot a lipstick cleanly into an open gap on the rotating wheel.

描述(中文): 抖音超火网红养成模拟我要开直播：搭建豪华直播间、签约人气主播带货涨粉，刷爆礼物弹幕一路赚成顶流大网红！
description(EN): Launch your own viral streaming studio—upgrade mics and lighting, recruit charismatic hosts, ride trending topics, and watch viewer gifts rocket into the millions.
controls: Tap to stream, upgrade studio equipment, unlock hot topics, and collect fan donations to expand your MCN agency.

描述(中文): 国民童年回忆经典飞行棋：摇出 6 点霸气起飞，踩同色格子连跳捷径、撞飞对手棋子，率先全机抵达终点夺冠！
description(EN): Roll the dice, launch your colorful fleet out of the hangar, ride shortcut flight lanes, bump rivals back to base, and race all four planes home.
controls: Tap the dice to roll, then tap any highlighted airplane token to move it along the colorful board track.

描述(中文): 经典数值策略地牢爬塔：精打细算每把红黄蓝钥匙、每一瓶血药与攻防宝石，步步为营挑战层层强敌。
description(EN): Plan every step through a multi-floor fantasy dungeon tower—collect colored keys, drink ruby potions, upgrade your blade, and calculate every monster duel.
controls: Use the on-screen directional pad or arrow/WASD keys to move, unlock color-coded doors, collect treasures, and battle monsters.

描述(中文): 国风清爽益智麻将解压馆：整理归类同款麻将牌凑齐消除，清脆碰牌手感配舒缓节奏越玩越上头！
description(EN): Stack, sort, and clear crisp Mahjong tiles in a relaxing brain-tickling sorting parlor—clean visual clarity and endlessly replayable layouts.
controls: Tap free Mahjong tiles to group matching pieces and clear the table cleanly.

描述(中文): 国风创新玩法麻将吃碰杠：把传统麻将吃碰杠胡牌规则融入爽快消除，连杠清屏爆分超刺激！
description(EN): Combine classic Chinese Mahjong Chow, Pong, and Kong melds with brisk puzzle clearing—build winning hands rapidly for explosive score combos.
controls: Tap Mahjong tiles to assemble valid sequences (Chow), triplets (Pong), or quads (Kong) and clear the table.

描述(中文): 清脆带感的 3D 麻将三消连碰：从立体牌堆中眼疾手快挑出三张同花色麻将，一碰即爆爽快清场。
description(EN): Pick glossy 3D mahjong tiles from stacked boards and snap matching triplets together in fast-paced chain combos before your tray fills up.
controls: Tap available 3D mahjong tiles to send them to your tray; match three identical tiles to pop them and use booster tools when stuck.

描述(中文): 不用凑番也能当雀神！整行整列「哗啦」一推，把两张相同的萬、筒、條、红中推到面对面直接碰走，节奏丝滑到根本停不下来。
description(EN): No hand-counting required — shove whole rows and columns of classic tiles until twins collide, snap pairs off the emerald felt, and clear the table.
controls: Tap adjacent matching tiles to clear them, or slide any row/column to line up pairs. Use Hint or Shuffle anytime.

描述(中文): 抖音微信超火麻将挪对对：整行整列丝滑推动麻将牌，让相同花色贴在一起瞬间消除，越玩越烧脑越上头！
description(EN): Slide entire rows and columns of crisp Mahjong tiles so identical pieces bump together and vanish—a fresh Sichuan-style logic twist that hooks players fast.
controls: Drag any tile horizontally or vertically to slide its line and align two matching Mahjong tiles side by side.

描述(中文): 抖音爆火剧情解谜帮她嫁入豪门：挑选精致穿搭、机智化解豪门考验与奇葩剧情，助女主一路开挂逆袭人生赢家！
description(EN): Guide our heroine through dramatic social makeovers, witty dialogue dilemmas, and hilarious plot twists on her whirlwind quest into high society.
controls: Tap props, outfits, and dialogue choices inside each comic scene to pass every high-society challenge.

描述(中文): 轻松爽快模拟料理金牌大厨餐厅：按单备料烹制诱人佳肴，升级菜单接待络绎不绝的吃货顾客成为五星名厨！
description(EN): Step behind the counter of a bustling neighborhood eatery—prep fresh dishes, keep every customer smiling, and grow into a Michelin-level chef.
controls: Tap ingredients and cooking stations to prepare and deliver each customer's requested dish.

描述(中文): 明快 3D 低多边形荒野狙击狩猎：在阳光林地里预判移动目标走位，稳准瞄准一击命中刷新高分纪录！
description(EN): Track fast-moving targets across sunlit low-poly wilderness ranges, steady your aim, and land pinpoint shots before time runs out.
controls: Hold and drag to move your aiming reticle onto moving targets, then release to fire.

描述(中文): 爆笑热梗找茬大合集！放大仔细搜遍离谱又熟悉的漫画名场面，揪出藏在角落里的穿帮细节与隐藏笑点。
description(EN): Hunt down hilarious visual gags, anachronisms, and sneaky meme details across comical cartoon scenes before the timer ticks down.
controls: Pan and zoom the illustrated scene, then tap every oddity or hidden meme clue to mark it off the list.

描述(中文): 抖音热榜爆款玩梗找茬王 30 关：30 关名场面热梗拉满，点击拖拽道具触发隐藏剧情，笑到停不下来！
description(EN): Conquer 30 laugh-out-loud viral meme stages—drag props, reveal hidden secrets, and uncover absurd plot twists in classic Douyin puzzle fashion.
controls: Tap suspicious spots or drag scene props onto characters to uncover all hidden meme clues.

描述(中文): 清新治愈翻牌益智记忆旅行：翻开绝美风景明信片两两配对消除，边锻炼记忆力边畅游梦幻世界！
description(EN): Flip scenic illustrated postcards to pair matching travel memories across charming global destinations—train your recall in relaxing stages.
controls: Tap two cards to flip them over and match identical travel scenes until the board is cleared.

描述(中文): 点击烤炉制作面团，拖动相同点心合成升级，交付顾客订单，90秒内赚满250金币。
description(EN): Bake dough, merge matching pastries and serve customer orders to earn $250 within 90 seconds.
controls: Tap the oven. Drag matching pastries together. Drag requested pastries onto customers.

描述(中文): 女性向顶流二合消除装扮梦想家园：拖拽合并相同工具与花艺完成订单，亲手把老房子翻新装扮成绝美梦幻豪宅！
description(EN): Drag and merge matching tools, flowers, and decor items on a cozy board to fulfill renovation orders and transform a fixer-upper villa into a dream home.
controls: Drag identical items together on the merge board to craft higher-tier pieces and complete home makeover tasks.

描述(中文): 策略合成与激爽塔防双融合：边合成升级强力防御单位、边指挥前线抵御 Boss 攻城，节奏紧凑超耐玩！
description(EN): Combine merge-upgrade economy with punchy wave combat—synthesize elite defenders, unlock synergy buffs, and crush towering siege bosses.
controls: Drag matching defender units together to level them up and defend your fortress against incoming waves.

描述(中文): 爆款二合塔防合成植物大战僵尸：拖拽两株相同植物秒变高阶超级射手，满屏豌豆冰瓜轰飞成群呆萌僵尸！
description(EN): Fuse matching pea-shooters, sunflowers, and frost plants into super-powered botanical defenders to blast waves of quirky zombies off your lawn.
controls: Drag two identical plants together to evolve a stronger turret and position them in lanes to stop incoming zombies.

描述(中文): 极简烧脑数字益智数字合成十：点击相连相同数字原地合体 +1，步步规划空间挑战合出终极数字 10！
description(EN): Tap connected groups of identical digits to fuse them into the next number up—keep your grid open and race to craft the elusive 10 tile!
controls: Tap clusters of two or more matching adjacent numbers to merge them into a higher digit.

描述(中文): 魔性上头放置策略合成塔防大师：召唤炮塔两两合成秒升神装，激光寒冰重炮齐发守住蜿蜒防线！
description(EN): Summon elemental turrets and merge matching tiers right on the winding battlefield to melt escalating enemy waves with laser, frost, and cannon fire.
controls: Tap to buy new turrets and drag identical levels together to merge stronger towers along the enemy path.

描述(中文): 海底奇幻主题美人鱼拔针救援 20 关：巧妙拉动海宫插销挡住鲨鱼与毒液、放水营救被困美人鱼，关卡精致又烧脑！
description(EN): Solve 20 handcrafted undersea pin-pulling puzzles—divert sharks and lava while guiding sparkling ocean water safely to reunite the little mermaid.
controls: Tap pins to remove barriers in sequence, neutralize ocean traps, and rescue the mermaid.

描述(中文): 治愈系精致立体模型组装：把零散的微缩模型零件逐一拼装归位，亲手还原一座座色彩明快的立体小景。
description(EN): Rotate and assemble charming miniature 3D models piece by piece, snapping each sculpted part cleanly into its slot to bring tiny dioramas to life.
controls: Drag sculpted model parts from the tray onto their matching slots on the miniature diorama until every piece clicks into place.

描述(中文): 动感丛林 3D 猴子快跑：化身机灵小猴在热带雨林与神庙赛道极速狂奔，腾空跃过滚木狂收香蕉冲刺高分！
description(EN): Sprint through lush jungle bridges and temple ruins as a nimble monkey—vault over rolling logs, scoop up golden bananas, and dash through speed rings.
controls: Swipe to change lanes, leap across gaps, and collect golden bananas along the jungle track.

描述(中文): 全球爆火萌猴经营超市神作：操控小猴现摘香蕉玉米、搬运补货上架、收银数钱雇帮手，打造最热闹的森林百货集市！
description(EN): Run a lively cartoon supermarket staffed by energetic monkeys—harvest bananas, fill stalls, ring up shoppers, and unlock bustling new aisles.
controls: Drag on screen with the virtual joystick to move your monkey manager, harvest produce, restock stands, and collect coins.

描述(中文): 超火动感电音节奏 3D 音乐球：跟随节拍单指滑动控制炫光小球精准踩点跳跃，沉浸式踩节拍爽到停不下来！
description(EN): Bounce a glowing rhythm orb across floating neon tiles to the beat—glide smoothly left and right to nail every center landing and keep the melody soaring.
controls: Press and drag left or right to guide the bouncing ball onto every glowing rhythm tile in sync with the beat.

描述(中文): 超上头的 3D 模拟经营汉堡店：亲自端盘上汉堡、疯狂收钞票、雇佣员工扩建餐桌和出餐台，把小店干成爆满连锁餐厅！
description(EN): Run your own bustling 3D burger restaurant—flip patties, serve sizzling orders, collect cash stacks, hire staff, and expand counters and seating.
controls: Drag anywhere on screen with the virtual joystick to move your chef, pick up freshly grilled burgers, serve customers, collect cash, and unlock upgrades.

描述(中文): 雨夜高架上的霓虹夜驰。穿梭车流、蓄满加速，刷新你的最远距离。
description(EN): Take a painted neon night drive on a rain-slick elevated highway. Weave through traffic, recharge your boost and chase a new distance record.
controls: Left / Right or A / D steer · Up / W / Space boost · click / tap left or right to steer · touch BOOST · P / Esc pause · R restart

描述(中文): 三封没寄出的信、一列雨夜列车、一段去海边的旅程。一个关于疏远的姐妹、一辆蓝色自行车和被原谅的勇气的分支故事。
description(EN): Three unsent letters, a rain-soaked night train and a journey to the sea. Follow a quiet branching story of estranged sisters, a blue bicycle and the courage to be forgiven.
controls: Click / tap choices, or press 1–2. Click the passage or press Space to reveal it; Space again takes the first choice. Tab / Enter for buttons. P / Escape to pause. R to restart.

描述(中文): 极度丝滑的 2248 数字连线合成：八方向一笔画串联相同及递增数字泡泡，瞬间合出超大倍数组合超级解压！
description(EN): Swipe across chains of matching and escalating number bubbles in all eight directions to fuse massive combos and chase endlessly higher powers of two.
controls: Press and drag across adjacent matching number circles (horizontal, vertical, or diagonal) to merge them into a larger number.

描述(中文): 蔚蓝海底珊瑚礁主题消除：伴随灵动可爱的卡通热带鱼群，连消海洋元素触发炫彩泡泡特效，轻松闯关。
description(EN): Dive into a vibrant coral reef aquarium to match charming tropical sea tiles, unleash bubble boosters, and climb through relaxing underwater stages.
controls: Tap Start to dive in, then match identical underwater sea creatures and tiles to clear each coral reef stage.

描述(中文): 抖音超火烧脑一笔画完：从起点出发不回头不重复，一笔串联点亮全场所有格子，看似简单却专治各种不服！
description(EN): Trace a single unbroken glowing line across every tile on the board without lifting your finger or retracing your path across hundreds of clever brain-teasers.
controls: Drag smoothly from the starting tile across adjacent squares to fill the entire grid in one continuous stroke.

描述(中文): 萌系经典射击消除熊猫泡泡龙：帮功夫小熊猫精准弹射彩色泡泡，击落整串泡泡救出被困萌娃超有成就感！
description(EN): Aim with an adorable kung-fu panda to bank colorful bubbles off bamboo walls, pop clusters of three or more, and free trapped baby cubs.
controls: Drag to aim the dotted trajectory and release to shoot bubbles into matching clusters.

描述(中文): 创意物理切割益智剪纸大师：看准目标虚线一刀利落裁开彩色折纸，考验空间直觉与精准手感超级解压！
description(EN): Slice colored origami sheets with one clean geometric cut to match exact target silhouettes and drop excess pieces cleanly away.
controls: Press and drag across the paper sheet to draw a straight cut line and carve out the required shape.

描述(中文): 高颜值国风剪纸美学纸中迷境华容道：精致纸雕画风配经典滑块华容道解谜，步步推演打开迷境通途！
description(EN): Immerse yourself in exquisite storybook paper-cut art—slide ornate blocks across atmospheric puzzle boards to guide the hero through mysterious realms.
controls: Slide rectangular paper blocks horizontally or vertically to clear a path for the hero piece to exit.

描述(中文): 微信畅玩榜常驻爆款挪车解谜：面对纵横交错堵死出口的停车场，理清先后顺序依次把每辆小车丝滑开出马路。
description(EN): Unclog chaotic city parking lots by choosing the right exit order for gridlocked cars without scraping bumpers.
controls: Tap or swipe vehicles along their lane direction to drive them safely out of the crowded lot.

描述(中文): 升起潜望镜，给海平线上的航母算好提前量再发射鱼雷；被驱逐舰听到就立刻下潜，在声呐图里躲开深水炸弹。一个 HTML 文件里的完整潜艇巡航。
description(EN): Raise the periscope, lead your torpedo onto a carrier on the horizon, then dive when a destroyer hears you and dodge depth charges on sonar. A whole submarine patrol in one HTML file.
controls: Left / Right or A / D turn the periscope · Space / click fire · S / Down dive · arrows steer on sonar · touch buttons on phones · P / Esc pause · R restart

描述(中文): 爽快特工潜行枪战闯关：化身王牌幽灵特工拉线精准瞄准，枪枪爆头或巧借角度干脆利落清剿全员目标！
description(EN): Line up slick action-movie shots as a stealth agent—aim clean angles, neutralize rival henchmen in rapid firefights, and clear every tactical stage.
controls: Hold and drag to aim your laser sight, release to fire crisp shots, and clear all targets in each mission.

描述(中文): 超萌农场版方向逃脱：牧场栅栏里挤满了朝向各异的胖小猪，找准突破口按顺序放飞全场小猪即可通关。
description(EN): Clear a bustling pasture packed with chubby piggies facing every direction—tap each animal in the right order to let the whole herd dash free.
controls: Tap any piggy with a clear path ahead to send it dashing out of the farmyard pen.

描述(中文): 创意爆款分类排序药丸与针管：把五彩小药丸按颜色精准装入对应透明针管，脑洞题材配经典排序超解压！
description(EN): Sort vibrant medicine capsules into color-matched syringes with crisp liquid-sort logic—quirky medical visuals meet ultra-clean puzzle satisfaction.
controls: Tap a syringe to pick up its top capsules, then tap a matching or empty syringe to transfer them.

描述(中文): 拔针让水与熔岩混合成石头，再把金币送给小人，挑战五关。
description(EN): Pull pins to mix water and lava, then deliver gold across five puzzles.
controls: Tap pins. Cool lava before releasing gold.

描述(中文): 超耐玩 2999 关经典物理弹球消砖块：一指拉线找准黄金反弹死角，几十颗弹球连环撞击清光满屏数字砖块超解压！
description(EN): Aim a growing stream of bouncing pinballs across 2,999 numbered brick stages—nail banked top-wall angles to shred hundreds of blocks in one volley.
controls: Drag to aim your dotted trajectory line, then release to fire a stream of bouncing balls that chip down numbered bricks.

描述(中文): 超丝滑硬币筹码归槽合成：把同面额硬币整齐码进同一卡槽，集满一键合成高阶筹码、解锁全新槽位，解压到停不下来。
description(EN): Sort and stack matching numbered coins across slotted trays, merge full stacks into higher-value chips, and unlock fresh slots in a deeply satisfying tactile sorting puzzle.
controls: Tap a coin stack to pick up matching chips and move them onto another matching or empty tray; deal fresh coins and tap Merge when a slot is full.

描述(中文): 经典解压逻辑接水管闯关：轻点旋转弯管与三通节点，严丝合缝接通整条水路瞬间畅通无阻，百玩不腻越玩越上头！
description(EN): Rotate elbows, junctions, and straight conduits on a crisp puzzle grid to build a sealed circuit and send pressurized water rushing from source to outlet.
controls: Tap any pipe segment to rotate it 90 degrees until every branch links cleanly into one leak-free flow path.

描述(中文): 复古街机像素飞机大战：纯粹硬核的像素风空战体验，丝滑操控狂射敌机刷新个人最高分！
description(EN): Blast retro pixel squadrons out of crisp arcade skies—crisp chiptune energy, snappy controls, and endless high-score dogfights.
controls: Drag to steer your pixel fighter, dodge enemy shots, and pick up firepower stars.

描述(中文): 超解压像素画方块消除：点选同色像素块连消清屏，一格一格击碎缤纷像素图案，看着整幅画面清脆崩解。
description(EN): Blast luminous pixel-art mosaics block by block—match vivid color clusters, trigger crisp chain clears, and watch every pixel artwork pop into confetti.
controls: Tap matching color pixel blocks or launchers to clear matching cubes from the board until the entire mosaic is gone.

描述(中文): 复古萌系像素海底世界像素鱼：操控小像素鱼穿梭珊瑚礁吃食成长、躲开大鱼追捕刷新深海得分！
description(EN): Swim through charming pixel reefs as a plucky little fish—dodge hungry predators, gobble plankton gems, and evolve larger fins.
controls: Tap or drag to swim smoothly through ocean currents, collect food, and dodge bigger fish.

描述(中文): 国民经典竖版弹幕雷霆飞机大战：单指驾驭王牌战机穿梭密集弹雨，吃道具暴走满屏散射轰爆巨型母舰！
description(EN): Pilot an ace fighter jet through classic vertical bullet-hell skies—grab twin-wing spread upgrades, trigger screen-clearing bombs, and smash giant airships.
controls: Drag anywhere on screen to pilot your jet, collect weapon upgrades, and dodge enemy bullet curtains.

描述(中文): 抖音魔性手速星球飞刀大作战：看准旋转星球空隙精准扎入飞刀，绝不撞刀一举劈开星球解锁炫酷神兵！
description(EN): Hurl razor knives into spinning cosmic planets without nicking embedded blades—crack each rotating core open to collect rare galactic daggers.
controls: Tap anywhere to launch a knife straight into the spinning planet while avoiding already stuck blades.

描述(中文): 国民级经典塔防回忆杀：收集阳光种植向日葵、豌豆射手与坚果墙，排兵布阵阻挡一波波来袭的僵尸大军。
description(EN): Defend your backyard lawn by gathering falling sun, planting peashooters, sunflowers, and walnut barriers, and halting waves of quirky zombies.
controls: Click Tap to Start, choose Adventure mode, collect falling sun orbs, and click seed packets then lawn tiles to plant defenders.

描述(中文): 国风水墨雅趣诗词飞花令：围绕花、月、春、风等诗眼连字成句，重温唐诗宋词名篇感受绝美东方意境！
description(EN): Celebrate classic Tang and Song poetry in an ink-wash puzzle arena—piece together famous verses around seasonal keywords like flower, moon, and spring.
controls: Tap scattered Chinese characters in order to assemble classic poetry lines matching the stage keyword.

描述(中文): 爽快升级桌游飞行棋大招版：在经典摇骰起飞基础上加入酷炫道具大招，逆风翻盘轰飞对手棋子欢乐加倍！
description(EN): Supercharge classic Aeroplane Chess with explosive power-up cards, turbo boosts, and shield skills for wildly unpredictable tabletop comebacks.
controls: Roll the dice, deploy special power cards, and move your fleet around the board first to win.

描述(中文): 软萌 Q 弹跳跃闯关布丁男孩：操控弹力十足的小布丁在甜品平台上步步高升，踩弹簧吃糖果直冲云霄！
description(EN): Bounce a jiggly caramel pudding hero upward across sweet dessert platforms—chain springs and fruit boosts sky-high.
controls: Tap or drag to guide Pudding Boy onto each higher platform while dodging hazards.

描述(中文): 买量点击率王者拔针帮她脱险：仔细思考插销拔出顺序，用水灭岩浆、用机关消灭怪物，顺利救出被困小姐姐！
description(EN): Slide golden pins in the smartest order to extinguish flames, neutralize monsters, drop treasure safely, and pull our heroine out of danger.
controls: Tap or pull pins in the right sequence so hazards cancel out and the character reaches safety.

描述(中文): 抖音超火 3D 变装跑酷美少女：在缤纷赛道收集时尚穿搭与闪耀配饰、躲避障碍陷阱，惊艳亮相终点 T 台拿下全场最高分！
description(EN): Dash down glamorous 3D runway courses—pick stylish outfits, collect sparkling accessories, dodge messy mud traps, and strike a winning pose at the finale.
controls: Swipe left and right to steer along the runway, grab matching fashion items, and avoid obstacles.

描述(中文): 极简烧脑套环三消神作：把大中小霓虹彩环拖进九宫格，横竖斜或同格三色连消触发炫酷连击停不下来！
description(EN): Drag concentric neon color rings onto a sleek grid—align three matching rings across rows, columns, or diagonals to ignite chain-reaction clears.
controls: Drag incoming concentric rings onto open pegs to match three of the same color in a row or stack.

描述(中文): 抖音刷屏机械解谜解锁圆环：旋转带缺口的彩色圆环找准角度逐一脱扣解开，宛如把玩真实鲁班锁超上瘾！
description(EN): Rotate interlocking slotted C-rings to line up gaps and slide every metal hoop cleanly free—a tactile mechanical puzzle straight off Douyin feeds.
controls: Drag to rotate any slotted ring until its gap lines up cleanly to slip off interlocking hoops.

描述(中文): 海内外飙升榜爆款 Bus Jam 港口版：调度挤在码头的各色小船驶向登船位，接走对应颜色排队的萌宠乘客扬帆起航。
description(EN): Send color-coded animal boats out of a crowded harbor pier so waiting passengers can board their matching vessel and set sail.
controls: Tap unblocked colored boats to move them to the boarding dock where matching animal passengers climb aboard.

描述(中文): 精巧解压 3D 滚动解谜球球要回家：巧妙操控弹力小球翻越机关坡道、避开陷阱沟壑，一路滚进终点小家！
description(EN): Tilt, steer, and time ramps to guide a lively rolling sphere across clever 3D puzzle tracks all the way safely into the glowing home goal.
controls: Drag to steer the rolling ball across bridges, switches, and ramps until it reaches the home portal.

描述(中文): 驾驶小无人机飞过街区，收齐 5 颗咖啡豆，降落在咖啡店屋顶就能兑换一杯咖啡。改一个 SHOP 配置，就能换成任何本地小店的推广小游戏。
description(EN): Fly a tiny drone over a city block, collect five coffee beans and land on the café roof to win a free coffee. A promo game any local business can rebrand by editing one SHOP object.
controls: Arrows / WASD fly · Q E or Shift / Space climb and descend · touch stick and ▲ ▼ on phones · P / Esc pause · R restart

描述(中文): 拟真物理 3D 拆绳挑战：把交错缠绕在木板铜柱上的彩色编织绳逐一挪位解开，丝滑拉直全盘清空。
description(EN): Untangle realistic physics-driven braided ropes knotted across brass board pins by moving anchors one slot at a time until every cord hangs free.
controls: Drag rope pins into open board sockets to uncross every tangled cord before running out of moves.

描述(中文): 极致解压的物理落沙消除：方块落地瞬间化作流动的细沙堆叠，只要同色沙层连通左右两边即可整片爽快消除。
description(EN): Drop vibrant blocks that shatter into flowing grains of colored sand on impact—connect a single color edge-to-edge to trigger huge cascading clears.
controls: Drag one of the three sand blocks at the bottom into the playfield; bridge left-to-right with one sand color to clear it.

描述(中文): 爆笑魔性跑酷香肠跑酷：化身软萌大香肠在厨房案板生死狂奔，极限下腰躲菜刀、跨过热油锅冲向终点！
description(EN): Dash through a hilarious kitchen gauntlet as a bendy cartoon sausage—duck under slicing knives, leap sizzling frying pans, and reach the finish unburnt.
controls: Hold to lean/slide under kitchen hazards and release to sprint cleanly past slicers and burners.

描述(中文): 超火益智物理画线救女孩：危急关头一笔画线挡住滚石毒蜂与机关陷阱，用你的神笔操作护送女孩安全通关！
description(EN): Sketch instant protective shields and clever paths to guard the heroine from falling hazards, rolling boulders, and mischievous traps.
controls: Draw a continuous line to block incoming dangers or guide the character safely past traps.

描述(中文): 超萌益智闯关救救小鸡：动脑破解机关陷阱、智斗偷鸡坏狐狸，把每一只呆萌小黄鸡平安护送回鸡窝！
description(EN): Outsmart sneaky foxes and tricky traps to rescue adorable baby chicks—solve clever physics puzzles and guide every fluffy chick safely back to the coop.
controls: Tap or drag interactive blocks, ropes, and barriers to clear a safe path and protect the chicks.

描述(中文): 全球爆火创意物理画线解谜：一笔画出一道坚固防线护住呆萌狗狗，在蜂巢狂蜂猛烈撞击下撑满倒计时即可过关。
description(EN): Sketch one continuous physics shield in mid-air to shelter an adorable pup from relentless angry honeybees for ten tense seconds.
controls: Hold and drag to draw a single continuous protective line around the dog, then release to test your barrier against the bees.

描述(中文): 治愈系 3D 解谜救救萌宠：仔细观察机关顺序，拉动障碍化解岩浆与陷阱，把可爱的小猫小狗全部平安救出！
description(EN): Pull pins, clear blockers, and solve clever stage contraptions to rescue puppies, kittens, and cute critters before danger strikes.
controls: Tap or slide pins and obstacles in the right sequence to guide pets safely to the exit.

描述(中文): 超上头 3D 校园模拟经营：从一间小教室起步，招生上课、扩建操场食堂与宿舍楼，一路升级打造顶级名校帝国！
description(EN): Build and manage your dream campus from a single classroom into a bustling academy—enroll students, upgrade lecture halls and sports fields, and grow your tuition empire.
controls: Tap facilities to expand classrooms, hire teachers, collect tuition income, and upgrade campus zones.

描述(中文): 今天也在赛博电子厂疯狂打工！一层层亚克力板死死叠在一起，挑准颜色把螺丝全拧进同色盒子，看着整块板子「咣当」掉下去，解压值直接拉满。
description(EN): Layered acrylic plates pinned tight by colorful bolts — pop the right screws into matching boxes, watch whole slabs drop free, and never jam your tray.
controls: Tap exposed screws to sort them into matching boxes (3 per box). Keep buffer holes clear and use power-ups when jammed.

描述(中文): 魔性奇幻风萨满消方块：巧妙排列图腾方块触发神秘萨满消除咒语，连锁清屏特效炫酷超上头！
description(EN): Drop mystical totem blocks into rhythmic columns and trigger glowing shamanic spell clears across upbeat tribal puzzle stages.
controls: Slide or place totem blocks into aligned rows and groups to ignite tribal clear combos.

描述(中文): 落日外滩开上红色超跑横冲直撞！6 星警车全城围堵、街头激战飙车，随时还能一键变身巨型机甲横扫魔都天际线。
description(EN): Tear through twilight Shanghai along the Bund in a crimson supercar, dodge 6-star police chases, and transform mid-battle into a towering skyline mecha!
controls: WASD move & drive, F hijack/enter vehicle, Right-Click aim, V transform mecha, 5 beam rifle, Tab switch protagonists.

描述(中文): 治愈系放置牧场小羊农场经营：在青青草原养满圆滚滚的小绵羊，剪羊毛加工纺织品卖大钱，扩建你的梦幻田园牧场！
description(EN): Raise fluffy sheep across sunlit green pastures—shear wool, craft cozy textiles, expand barns, and build a thriving countryside ranch.
controls: Tap pastures and workshops to breed sheep, shear wool, upgrade production lines, and sell goods for coins.

描述(中文): 左右拖动换道，躲避障碍、收集金币和加速道具，撞三次结束。
description(EN): Change lanes, gather coins and boost through an accelerating neon course.
controls: Drag to change lanes. Three hits ends the run.

描述(中文): 穿过霓虹雨夜，在屋顶间奔跑、跳跃和蹬墙，90 秒内将三个包裹送达城市高处。
description(EN): One courier. Three last deliveries. Run, leap and kick off walls to deliver all three parcels in 90 seconds.
controls: A / D or arrows move · W / Up / Space jump and wall-jump · mouse/touch hold direction pads and tap Jump · P / Esc pause · R restart

描述(中文): 复古工位掌机风合成小游戏：拖动投放并合并 11 级职场摸鱼动作，一路进化出「带薪躺平大王」，自带一键「老板来了」伪装表格护盾。
description(EN): Drop and merge 11 hilarious office slacking habits—from sipping water to the ultimate Paid-Relaxation King—with a one-tap Boss Coming spreadsheet shield.
controls: Drag or move pointer to aim and release to drop; merge matching icons to evolve. Use Pantry Shake, Mark All Read, and the Boss Coming spreadsheet shield anytime.

描述(中文): 拖动史莱姆吞掉较小物体，60 秒内与三个对手争夺体积排名。
description(EN): Eat smaller city objects and outrank three rival slimes in sixty seconds.
controls: Drag to eat smaller objects and grow. Rival contact does not reduce your volume.

描述(中文): 经典滑雪大冒险风横版雪地冲刺：踩跳台凌空后空翻加速、躲避巨石冰坡，在滚滚雪崩追上之前极限狂奔！
description(EN): Carve down crisp alpine slopes in a snappy side-scrolling ski runner—launch off ramps, pull clean mid-air flips, and stay ahead of the roaring snowball avalanche.
controls: Tap or press Space to jump over rocks and obstacles; hold in mid-air to perform speed-boosting backflips and land cleanly.

描述(中文): 魔性 IO 竞技奔跑吧雪球：滚起巨无霸雪球把对手统统撞飞冰面，活到最后成为冰雪王者！
description(EN): Roll a giant snowball across frosty arenas, scoop up snow to grow massive, and bump rival players right off the ice rink!
controls: Drag to roll your snowball bigger across the ice and release to hurl or bump rivals off the edge.

描述(中文): 快节奏 2D 街机足球大乱斗：一分钟一局随时开踢，腾空倒钩大力抽射破门，体验拳拳到肉的爆爽绿茵对决！
description(EN): Jump into fast-paced 2D arcade soccer duels—sprint, leap for power kicks, outmaneuver your rival on a lively stadium pitch, and smash goals before the buzzer.
controls: Use on-screen movement, jump, and kick controls (or keyboard arrows/buttons) to dribble, volley, and score past the rival.

描述(中文): 点选起点再点终点，将同色圆环归到一柱，支持撤销，90秒挑战由易到难的五关。
description(EN): Pour matching top rings between poles, undo mistakes and solve five increasingly complex sorting puzzles.
controls: Tap a source pole, then a target pole. Only matching top colors can stack. Tap Undo to reverse a move.

描述(中文): 炫酷霓虹街机太空弹球：弹射能量光球撞击星际保险杠与加分轨道，左右拨板极限救球刷爆高分榜！
description(EN): Launch glowing energy spheres into a neon cosmic pinball table—smash glowing bumpers, trigger multiplier ramps, and keep the ball alive with crisp flippers.
controls: Pull to launch the ball and tap left/right screen sides to fire the neon pinball flippers.

描述(中文): 怀旧红白机情怀松鼠大战：操控敏捷小松鼠跑跳搬箱子砸小怪，重温经典横版动作闯关的纯粹快乐！
description(EN): Relive beloved classic platformer charm—leap across treetop stages, lift and toss acorns and crates at cheeky foes, and collect sparkling nuts.
controls: Move, jump, pick up crates, and toss them at enemies across lively retro stages.

描述(中文): 在云上一块一块叠起月光天文台，时机准就完美落位。连续完美落位能修复塔身，一路叠进星空。
description(EN): Build a moonlit observatory above the clouds, one perfectly timed stone at a time. Chain perfect landings to restore your tower and climb into the stars.
controls: Click, tap or Space to stack. P / Escape to pause. R to restart. Sound starts after your first input.

描述(中文): 科幻炫酷 3D 星际逃逸：驾驶星际战机穿梭霓虹陨石带与太空隧道，极速闪避激光障碍刷新光年纪录！
description(EN): Pilot a sleek starship weaving through neon asteroid rings and orbital tunnels—dodge energy barriers at hyperspeed and chase cosmic distance records.
controls: Drag left and right to bank your starship around space obstacles and collect energy boosts.

描述(中文): 浩瀚星际弹幕空战星河边境：驾驶星舰守卫银河防线，强化等离子重炮扫荡外星舰队爽感拉满！
description(EN): Command an interstellar cruiser patrolling the galaxy rim—upgrade twin plasma turrets and blast alien fleets across deep-space sectors.
controls: Drag to pilot your starship, dodge cosmic plasma fire, and grab weapon power-ups.

描述(中文): 守护发光的晶核，击退五波体素敌人。边移动边瞄准射击，每波结束后选择升级，让这座小小的堡垒继续闪耀。
description(EN): Defend a luminous crystal against five waves of voxel invaders. Move, aim and hold the line; between waves, choose the upgrade that keeps your small world alive.
controls: WASD / arrows move · Mouse aims + hold click fires · Space auto-aims + fires · Touch: drag to move + auto-fire · FIRE button auto-aims · 1–3 choose upgrades · P / Esc pause · R restart

描述(中文): 魔性脑洞物理平衡别离开碗：精准把控落点把各式搞怪物品全装进小碗里，倒计时结束一颗不掉才算赢！
description(EN): Juggle tumbling marbles, candies, and quirky shapes inside a tilting ceramic bowl—keep every piece balanced inside until the timer ticks down.
controls: Drag to aim each drop gently into the bowl so nothing spills over the rim.

描述(中文): 畅快街机绿茵竞技棒棒足球：灵巧盘带过人、大力抽射轰出世界波，一分钟爽踢一局随时开赛！
description(EN): Dash across a lively pitch in snappy arcade soccer clashes—dribble past defenders, hammer curving power shots, and bury goals top-corner.
controls: Move your striker with on-screen controls and tap shoot/jump buttons to outscore your rival.

描述(中文): 魔性横版动作火柴人三国：简约带感的火柴人武将化身三国名将，大招连放率领大军冲锋陷阵爽感十足！
description(EN): Clash across lively stickman battlefields starring iconic Three Kingdoms warriors—unleash sweeping spear combos and rally legions to conquer China.
controls: Use directional and attack/skill buttons to slash through rival stickman squads and command troops.

描述(中文): 经典高能横版火柴人狙击暗杀：阅读悬赏情报、开倍镜稳准锁定目标要害，一枪毙命完成全套特工任务！
description(EN): Peer through a steady sniper scope across rooftop and city missions—read target briefs, line up clean headshots, and take down every mark.
controls: Drag to aim your sniper scope crosshair onto the mission target, then tap or release to fire a precision shot.

描述(中文): 全民休闲减压神器超级解压馆：一分钟一局轻松归类消除，满屏整齐清屏瞬间释放所有压力！
description(EN): Dive into bite-sized satisfying organizing and matching levels—clear cluttered trays with crisp audio pops and zero-stress pacing.
controls: Tap matching objects and clear cluttered boards smoothly one satisfying combo at a time.

描述(中文): 超上头模拟经营超市大亨：补满生鲜货架、加快收银结账、招募店员扩建卖场，从街头小店一路干成亿万连锁商超！
description(EN): Build and expand a bustling mini-supermarket empire—stock fresh shelves, ring up eager customers, hire helpers, and watch profits pile sky-high.
controls: Tap and drag to manage departments, restock goods, unlock new aisles, and collect cash earnings.

描述(中文): 高颜值少女心爆棚甜心公主换装记：海量华丽礼服、梦幻发型与闪耀配饰自由搭配，打造专属二次元人气小公主！
description(EN): Style adorable anime princesses with hundreds of hairstyles, sparkling gowns, ribbons, and pastel accessories to win dazzling fashion showdowns.
controls: Tap wardrobe tabs to mix and match hairstyles, dresses, shoes, and accessories for your princess.
