描述(中文): 抖音爆款动作射击我坦克开得贼溜：单指灵活操控小坦克风骚走位躲炮弹，升级双管加农炮横扫敌军装甲团！
description(EN): Steer a nimble mini-tank around destructible battlefields—dodge mortar shells, upgrade double cannons, and blast rival armor into smithereens.
controls: Drag to maneuver your tank while auto-aiming and firing shells at enemy turrets and tanks.

描述(中文): 清爽减压横版打靶射击：瞄准移动标靶稳准扣动扳机，枪枪十环红心触发爆分连击！
description(EN): Steady your sights across shifting bullseyes and swinging targets—nail crisp 10-ring streaks before ammo runs dry.
controls: Aim the reticle over moving bullseye targets and tap to fire clean center shots.

描述(中文): 抖音超火拖拽方块消除俄罗斯方块大爆炸：自由摆放彩色积木填满整行或整列瞬间引爆清屏，连消爽到停不下来！
description(EN): Drag vibrant polyomino pieces onto a clean 8x8 grid to blast full rows and columns in dazzling chain combos—no timer stress, pure brainy flow.
controls: Drag each block shape onto the board to complete full horizontal or vertical lines and trigger combo blasts.

描述(中文): 国民永恒益智经典俄罗斯方块：旋转落块严丝合缝码齐整行瞬间消除，丝滑手感随时来一局消磨时光！
description(EN): Rotate and drop crisp falling tetrominoes to clear four-line Tetrises in silky-smooth arcade physics—pure timeless block-stacking mastery.
controls: Tap rotate, left, right, and drop buttons (or arrow keys) to fit falling blocks into complete horizontal lines.

描述(中文): 热血Q版策略对战三国听我指挥：率领关羽张飞赵云排兵布阵，调遣步骑弓兵一路攻城拔寨横扫三国战场！
description(EN): Lead legendary Three Kingdoms generals in punchy tactical skirmishes—summon cavalry, archers, and siege units at the right beat to storm rival castles.
controls: Tap troop cards and general skills to deploy formations and overwhelm enemy armies.

描述(中文): 单手畅玩物理弹射拇指弹球：一根大拇指拉线发射弹球，精准弹射几何障碍收割星星轻松闯关！
description(EN): Play effortless one-thumb arcade pinball—ricochet balls off bouncy geometric shapes, snag extra-ball rings, and climb endless combo stages.
controls: Drag with one thumb to aim and release to bounce pinballs across target shapes and power rings.

描述(中文): 驾驶快艇穿越风暴群岛。跃过浪尖、避开暗礁，在倒计时结束前通过八个检查点中的至少六个。
description(EN): Race a speedboat through a storm-lashed archipelago. Jump wave crests, dodge reefs and reach at least six of eight checkpoints before the tide runs out.
controls: A / D or arrows steer · W accelerates · S brakes · Space jumps · Mouse: hold and steer · Touch: drag to steer or use buttons · P / Esc pause · R restart

描述(中文): 草莓仓鼠喊你来破关！第 1 关三秒学会，第 2 关起层层叠叠暗藏杀机——到底能闯到第几关？移出、撤回、洗牌三大法宝全给你配齐了。
description(EN): Easy to learn on Stage 1, devilishly layered from Stage 2 onward — clear the strawberry hamster's stacked farm tiles using Undo, Pop-out and Shuffle.
controls: Tap unblocked tiles into the 7-slot tray to clear triples. Save Undo, Pop-out and Shuffle for tight layers.

描述(中文): 拖动倾斜悬浮迷宫，让小球避开陷阱、取得钥匙并进入出口，挑战三关计时星级。
description(EN): Tilt a floating labyrinth, collect the key and guide a rolling orb to the portal across three timed stages.
controls: Hold and drag to tilt; release to brake. Collect the key, then reach the portal.

描述(中文): 复古像素横版冒险小小勇者：化身勇敢小骑士挥剑斩史莱姆、跨越机关陷阱探索神秘地牢宝藏！
description(EN): Explore vibrant pixel dungeons as a brave miniature knight—leap pitfalls, slash slimes, and uncover hidden treasure chests.
controls: Use arrow keys / WASD (or on-screen controls) to move, jump, and swing your sword at dungeon foes.

描述(中文): 超上头微型玩具兵团对战：带领蓝色小兵、吉普车和迷你坦克冲锋占点，扩编军团一路推平红方堡垒！
description(EN): Lead chibi blue squads, jeeps, and mini-tanks across tactical island battlefields to outnumber red garrisons and capture every enemy flag.
controls: Drag to lead your commander and squads across the battlefield, recruit reinforcements, and capture enemy strongholds.

描述(中文): 微信爆款魔性一指跳跃豆腐公主：看准左右滑来的嫩豆腐一键起跳稳稳踩正中心，越堆越高解锁可爱公主皮肤！
description(EN): Time crisp one-tap jumps to stack wobbly slices of silky tofu higher and higher beneath an adorable princess—nail center landings for golden combo boosts.
controls: Tap anywhere to make the princess leap straight onto each incoming tofu block and stack sky-high.

描述(中文): 吉卜力风治愈奇幻森林魔法物语：携手呆萌森林精灵施展魔法、收集闪亮松果与宝物，开启梦幻林间物语！
description(EN): Step into a whimsical enchanted forest—cast cozy spells, gather glowing acorns, and solve charming woodland puzzles with magical companions.
controls: Tap magical tiles and forest companions to trigger combos and clear every enchanted stage.

描述(中文): 奇幻冒险策略塔防英雄：招募弓箭手、大法师与重甲骑士据守要道，升级英雄技能击退魔物大军保卫王国！
description(EN): Deploy heroic archers, mages, and knights along scenic fantasy trails—upgrade skill trees mid-battle and defend the kingdom gates.
controls: Place hero units on strategic spots along the path and tap upgrades as enemy waves intensify.

描述(中文): 极简魔性节奏堆塔神作：看准时机一键定格滑行方块，切掉多余边角或触发完美重合冲击直插云霄的摩天高塔！
description(EN): Time every tap to stack sliding neon 3D slabs sky-high—slice away overhangs with razor precision or chain perfect snaps to expand your towering skyscraper.
controls: Tap anywhere at the exact moment the moving slab aligns with the tower beneath it to lock it cleanly in place.

描述(中文): 畅快横版卡通跑酷印第安快跑：化身部落勇士穿越峡谷图腾赛道，二段跳躲巨石收集宝石冲刺极限距离！
description(EN): Sprint across vibrant totem canyons and jungle vines—vault over rolling boulders, double-jump chasms, and gather gleaming tribal relics.
controls: Tap jump (double-tap for higher leaps) and slide controls to dodge jungle hazards and collect coins.

描述(中文): 爽快冲刺跑酷疯跑英雄：控制英雄全速狂飙、撞破障碍吃满加速能量，一路狂奔直冲终点！
description(EN): Dash at breakneck speed across action-packed obstacle tracks—smash crates, collect power boosts, and race past every trap to the finish.
controls: Swipe to dodge hazards, jump gaps, and grab speed boosts along the track.

描述(中文): 聚会破冰神器双人同屏派对：一部设备就能同屏互怼 PK，涵盖多款快节奏反应对抗小游戏，越玩越嗨！
description(EN): Challenge a friend on the same screen or battle smart bots across brisk head-to-head mini-games packed with instant laughs and reflex duels.
controls: Pick a mini-game and tap your half of the screen to outplay your opponent or AI rival.

描述(中文): 抖音超火强迫症福音最强解压馆：汇聚整理收纳、清爽消除与趣味解压挑战，每一声清脆反馈都超级治愈！
description(EN): Unwind with an ultra-satisfying collection of tactile sorting, popping, and neat-stacking mini-puzzles engineered for pure ASMR zen.
controls: Tap and drag items to tidy, match, and clear every relaxing stress-relief puzzle stage.

描述(中文): 魔性拆螺丝闯关关不住我：拧松层层铁锁与机关螺栓，破解严密机关顺利脱身，节奏紧凑越玩越爽！
description(EN): Twist free trapped latches, iron bars, and color-coded bolts to spring open every locked contraption and break out cleanly.
controls: Tap bolts and empty sockets strategically to detach every locking bar blocking your escape.

描述(中文): 经典烧脑物理拆解拆螺丝 51 关：精挑细选 51 个层层递进的拧螺丝挑战，步步为营拆光铁板越玩越停不下来！
description(EN): Tackle 51 escalating mechanical unbolting puzzles—relocate bolts smartly without jamming holes so every interlocked plate drops clear.
controls: Tap any bolt and move it to an empty socket to free overlapping plates and clear the puzzle.

标题: 罪恶海滩：滨海九洞高尔夫
描述(中文): 面朝碧海棕榈挥杆打满九洞！按住空格蓄力卡准金色完美区，一杆飞越海湾潮口、果岭精准推杆，还能随时和三位电脑对手同场比杆。
description(EN): Tee off along nine sunlit Miami-bay links holes! Hold Space to nail the gold sweet spot, curve drives over tidal inlets, and outplay three rivals under palm-fringed sunset skies.
controls: Drag / WASD or Arrows aim, Q/E or Scroll switch club, F shot type, hold & release Space to swing, Shift preview, R reset.

描述(中文): 开上白色复古敞篷车，在日落棕榈海滩与雨夜自由城大桥狂飙！贴尾吸风、弯道甩尾攒氮气、直接撞飞对手，赢了积分还能进车库改装引擎和撞击装甲。
description(EN): Tear across sunset Art Deco palms and rain-slicked Liberty bridges in a 3D ASCII convertible — chain drifts, slipstream boosts, paint-trading bumps, and garage upgrades.
controls: W/S or Up/Down to drive, A/D or Left/Right to steer, hold Space to drift, double-tap Space for nitro, C to cycle 4 cameras (including cockpit).

描述(中文): 会动的创意视频拼图！每一块拼图都在实时播放动态画面，顺着画面运动轨迹把碎片拼成一段完整流畅的动态影片。
description(EN): Assemble live moving-video puzzle tiles while the clip plays in real time—track motion across seams and lock every animated piece into one seamless cinema frame.
controls: Drag animated video puzzle pieces onto matching slots by following the live moving footage until the full video plays seamlessly.

描述(中文): 轻肉鸽策略塔防：开局免费抽装备宝箱强化战力，排兵布阵并挑选局内技能流派，守卫村庄抵御怪物狂潮。
description(EN): Collect gear chests, deploy hero skills, and upgrade tower defenses to protect your peaceful meadow village from relentless monster waves.
controls: Open starter chests to equip gear, tap Battle to start defending, and choose roguelite skill upgrades between monster waves.

描述(中文): 清新卡通策略塔防村庄守卫战：修建箭塔与路障、集结勇者卫队击退强盗怪潮，守卫家园步步升级防线！
description(EN): Rally brave villagers and construct clever wooden watchtowers to fend off raiders—upgrade barricades and protect your peaceful frontier settlement.
controls: Tap tower pads to build and upgrade defenses, and deploy reinforcements whenever enemies push forward.

描述(中文): 海外长青榜霸榜神作 Vita 大字麻将对对碰：清晰大牌面一眼看清，轻松配对消除多层国风麻将牌局，老少皆宜超解压！
description(EN): Relax with crisp oversized Mahjong tiles inspired by the global Vita Mahjong phenomenon—pair matching free tiles cleanly across layered boards to clear every handcrafted layout.
controls: Tap two identical uncovered Mahjong tiles with at least one open side to match and clear them from the board.

描述(中文): 全球十亿级爆款液体颜色排序：把五颜六色的分层液体在不同玻璃试管间巧妙倒腾，直到每支试管都装满单一纯色。
description(EN): Pour luminous colored liquids smoothly between glass test tubes until every vial holds a single pure hue.
controls: Tap a bottle to lift it, then tap another bottle with matching top color or empty space to pour.

描述(中文): 现象级 Suika 水果物理合成 3D 升级版：瞄准落点投下 Q 弹水果，两个相同水果相撞进化升级，一路合成终极大西瓜。
description(EN): Aim and drop bouncy 3D fruits into a physics container—collide identical fruits to evolve them step by step into a colossal watermelon.
controls: Drag left or right to position the next fruit and release to drop; match identical fruits to merge bigger ones.

描述(中文): 全民童年街机欢乐打地鼠：拿起大木槌眼疾手快猛敲冒头捣蛋地鼠，连击狂暴加分注意别敲到炸弹哦！
description(EN): Grab your cartoon mallet and bop cheeky helmeted moles popping out of meadow burrows—chain fever combos while sparing innocent critters and bombs.
controls: Tap rapidly on popping moles to score combo streaks while avoiding bombs and penalty targets.

描述(中文): 抖音爆笑玩梗脑洞解谜合集：花式找茬、反套路互动、离谱名场面层出不穷，挑战你的清奇脑回路！
description(EN): Crack outrageous comic brain-teasers and spot hilarious hidden meme twists across dozens of absurdly funny puzzle stages.
controls: Tap, drag, or combine unexpected clues inside each cartoon scene to solve every wacky riddle.

描述(中文): 清爽畅快 3D 冬日极限跳伞：从雪山高空纵身跃下，穿梭空中光环躲避冰峰，精准控伞稳稳降落靶心赢高分！
description(EN): Leap into crisp alpine skies, glide through glowing aerial rings, steer past snowy peaks, and nail a bullseye parachute touchdown.
controls: Drag to steer your skydiver through score rings and guide your parachute cleanly onto the landing target.

描述(中文): 高级木质质感多合一木头益智合集：集合拼块、华容道等多款耐玩经典桌游，温润手感一套玩个够！
description(EN): Enjoy a warm handcrafted wooden tabletop collection featuring classic block-fit, sliding, and logic brain-teasers all in one cozy package.
controls: Choose a wooden tabletop puzzle from the menu and drag pieces into place to clear each stage.

描述(中文): 纸牌接龙 × 联想分类脑洞玩法：翻开桌面词卡与图卡，把同一主题的卡片成组归位收齐，越排越上头。
description(EN): Flip, drag, and group mixed word and picture cards by shared topic into target category slots in a clever solitaire-style sorting puzzle.
controls: Drag matching word or picture cards onto their category cards or empty sorting slots; tap the deck to flip fresh cards.

描述(中文): 极简国风创意文字塔防：在卷轴战场上排兵布阵、构筑特色文字炮塔并合成升级，迎战一波波文字军团入侵。
description(EN): Deploy and upgrade ink-calligraphy defense towers across a scroll battlefield to hold back escalating waves of shadowy invaders.
controls: Tap build tiles to place and upgrade word towers along the winding lane, and spend earned gold to strengthen your defense.

描述(中文): 国粹烧脑精品象棋经典残局：收录海量古谱名局与街边绝杀残局，弃车保帅步步将军，棋艺瞬间精进！
description(EN): Solve legendary Chinese Chess endgame masterpieces—calculate sharp chariot sacrifices, double-cannon checkmates, and clever knight forks.
controls: Tap a red piece and choose a highlighted square to deliver forced checkmate in the classic endgame puzzle.

描述(中文): 超治愈 ASMR 毛线整理填色：把杂乱的彩色毛线按同色凑齐三根归槽，一针一线织出隐藏的像素画作。
description(EN): Sort cozy bundles of colorful wool yarn into matching trays of three to weave vibrant pixel-art tapestries stitch by stitch.
controls: Tap yarn slots to pick up and transfer matching wool colors; complete sets of three to weave pixels onto the canvas.

描述(中文): 高燃 3D 尸潮围城防守：在四面受敌的末日据点架起喷火塔、锯片陷阱和机枪阵地，硬扛一波波狂暴尸潮！
description(EN): Fortify a 3D outpost surrounded by swarms of undead—deploy traps, upgrade defensive towers, and mow down wave after wave of zombies closing in from every angle.
controls: Drag to move your defender around the base, collect resources, and step on build zones to upgrade walls, traps, and firepower.

描述(中文): 国民回忆杀神作经典祖玛：旋转神庙石像发射彩色弹珠，精准打入滚珠长龙触发连锁三消爆破，在进洞前全清通关！
description(EN): Rotate an ancient stone launcher in the heart of jungle ruins—shoot colorful marbles into rolling chains to spark explosive match-3 combos before they reach the skull.
controls: Aim with pointer or touch and click/tap to fire colorful marbles into the rolling track to match three or more.
